tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dgyes rdor mar lugs kyi khrid yig 'khrul med nges gsang zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru/ kun khyab ye shes 'gyur ba med pa yang*/ /bde gsal he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor du/ /nam yang shar ba e waṃ yi ge mchog /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la rtag tu 'dud/ /mchog tu zab pa'i man ngag ni/ /grub thob brgyud pa'i zhal lung la/ /mkhas 'dod spros pas ma bslad pa/ / 'di 'dra thos pa'ang skal ba bzang*/ /'dir rgyud thams cad kyi snying po lta bu dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag lag len gyi rim pa/ jo bo nā ro ta pa'i zhal lung*/ lo tswa ba rnal 'byor dbang phyug mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyi gyi thugs bcud gang yin pa de bri bar bya'o/ /spyir mar pa'i gdams ngag rdzogs rim thams cad la/ bsre ba dang 'pho ba'i brda chad re mdzad mod kyang*/ gdams ngag 'di la ni khyad par du yang dgyes pa rdo rje'i 'khrid bsre 'pho zhes grags so/ /'di nyams su len par byed pa la/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ tshogs bsag pa maṇḍal gyi khrid dang*/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba yi ge brgya pa'i khrid ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor yang spyi dang 'dra ste/ go rim gyi khrigs ni/ mdun du gdan bzhi rdzogs kyi steng du/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang du bsgom/ phyag mchod sngon du 'gro ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ gsol ba drag tu 'debs/ bla ma'i sku las 'od zer gyi dbang bzhi len/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas stim/ rang sems dang gnyis su med par 'jog pa'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro ni/ yig rnying rnams kyi dngos bstan la/ gtum mo kho na'i sngon 'gro yin pa ltar bshad mod kyi/ yig chung gzhan rnams las kyang sngon 'gro gtum mo la kha 'phangs shing*/ lag len la ni bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid gang bsgoms kyang sngon 'gror 'debs so/ /de la gnyis/ srung 'khor sgom pa dang tshogs bsag pa gnyis/ dang po la/

hūṃ yig gi srung 'khor dang khro bo'i srung 'khor ro/ /dang po ni/ gnas khang yid dang mthun pa zhig tu/ 'grub na maṇḍal dang mchod gtor sngon du btang*/ de min skyabs sems dran tsam byas/ lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun bca'/ rlung ro bsal/ rang dgyes rdor he ru ka'am bdag med ma'i nga rgyal bya'o/ /de nas rlung gi rnal 'byor ni rlung dal bus phyir bus nas thub tshad phyir bzung*/ yang dal bus nang du rngubs nas nang du thub tshad bzung*/ dmigs pa ni/ lte bar hūṃ sngon po sor bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba zhig bsgom/ rlung phyir gtong ba'i dus su/ lte ba'i hūṃ las hūṃ phra mo dpag tu med pa sna sgo nas phar spros/ rlung phyir 'dzin pa'i skabs su/ rgya chen por song nas hūṃ gi sa gzhi dang ra ba dang gur du gyur/ yang rlung nang du 'jug pa'i tshe/ hūṃ dpag tu med pa sna sgo nas tshur 'dus te lus nang khengs/ nang du bzung ba'i tshe ba spu'i bu ga tshun chod hūṃ gi go chas go mtshams med par gtams par bsam/ nyin zhag gcig la snga dro thun gnyis/ phyi dro thun gnyis/ srod dang tho rangs kyi thun re re ste/ thun drug tu bcad nas thun re re bzhin rlung thengs mang ba la tshad med/ nyung mtha' la yang gong du smos pa'i rlung khug pa de/ lan nyi shu'am/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi re mi sgom pa'i thabs med pa'o/ /dmigs pa 'di brtan pa'i tshad ni/ rlung 'gro 'ong la/ hū?ṃ yig 'gro 'ong gi gsal snang 'byung*/ zhag bcu tsam na 'ong gsung ste/ dbang po rnon po la dgongs pa yin/ dgos pa ni/ sgom nyes mi 'byung phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad srung ba'o/ /gnyis pa yang de dang 'dra ba las/ hūṃ spro bsdu 'gro 'ong byed pa'i tshab tu/ lte ba'i hūṃ las/ dgyes rdor gyi khro chung spro bsdu 'gro 'ong dang*/ khro bo'i srung 'khor dang go char gyur par bsgom/ gzhan thams cad gong dang 'dra/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog gis mi tshugs pa'i dgos pa yod/

gang zag gcig gis dmigs pa 'di kho na gnyis kar sgom dgos pa min/ gang la mos pa zhig sgom mo gsung yang gnyis ka byung na legs/ gnyis pa tshogs bsag pa ni/ nyams len gyi rim pa dang bya byed spyod tshul srung 'khor gyi rigs 'gre/ dmigs pa ni rang gi mdun du padma'i sdong po rgyas pa'i rtse la/ padma dmar po 'dab bzhi pa'i lte bar zla gdan gcig sgom rang gi lte bar yang pad zla'i steng du/ bla ma mi bskyod pa he ru ka'am rdo rje 'chang zhig bsgom/ rlung sbyor ni srung 'khor gyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe/ lte ba'i bla ma de yar byon/ sna sgo nas 'thon/ mdun gyi pad zla'i steng du 'khod par sgom/ rlung phyir bzung ba'i skabs/ mdun gyi bla ma zhal 'dzum me ba la sems bstad de/ yid kyis mchod pa dang gsol ba 'debs pa dran tsam bya/ rlung nang du 'ong ba'i tshe/ mdun gyi bla ma de tshur byon rang gi sna sgo nas zhugs/ lte ba'i pad zla'i steng du 'khod rlung nang du bzung ba'i skabs/ lte ba'i bla ma 'dzum zhal can la dmigs/ yid kyi mchod pa dang gsol 'debs dran tsam bya/ de nyid thun drug tu sgom tshul dang*/ brtan pa'i tshad sogs kyang gong bzhin/ dgos pa ni dam tshig nyams chags skong ba dang*/ tshogs kyi sgo mang po gsog pa dang*/ bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bsre ba'i gdams ngag dang*/ 'pho ba'i gdams ngag gnyis so/ /dang po la bskyed rim gyi khrid dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi khrid gnyis las/ dang po bskyed rim la yang gsum te/ rnam pa la bslab pa/ thig le la bslab pa/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug la bslab pa/ dang po ni dben khang gcig tu bris sku dgram maṇḍal mchod pa dang*/ gtor chog sngon du 'gro bas/ dgyes rdor ram/ bdag med ma'i mngon rtog shar gyis bsgoms nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsdus te/ gtso rkyang gi nga rgyal la gnas pas bris sku la yud tsam bltas/

de nyid rang la bkab cing bsgom/ de ltar bris sku la blta ba dang*/ rang nyid bsgom pa spel ba de/ mthangs dkar ba'i dus kyi thun gnyis la yang yang bsgom/ grangs kyi nges pa med/ thun gzhan rnams la lha sku'i rnam pa gsal rung mi gsal rung*/ res bsgrims te gsal 'debs pa dang*/ 'phro bcad kyin bsgom/ res lha yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang*/ lha'i rnam pa yod tshul tsam la/ shes pa ngal gso yin slong gin bsgom/ de dag gi bogs 'don du skabs 'gar bris sku la 'od sna tshogs 'char du bcug /gzhan la ma yengs par de kho na la yun ring du blta mig btsum nas/ rang nyid de 'dra bar yud tsam re bsgom/ nyin tser gyis de kas bzla bar bya/ thun mtshams dang mtshan mo gang yang yid la mi byed/ dper mtshon na zla ba gcig la zhag nyi shu rtsa bdun dmigs pa dkyus ma de bsgom/ zhag gsum bogs 'don de bsgoms na/ zla drug lta bu myur du gsal snang thob yong ba yin/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka'i mngon rtogs sngar bzhin bsgoms nas/ rdo rje nor bu'i dbus su thig le dkar la zlum pa/ 'od 'tsher ba sran chung tsam mam yungs 'bru tsam zhig rtag tu bsgom/ bar bar du rig pa ma bcos par ngal bso/ lung sbyor gang rung zhig dang bstun na legs/ gal te bdag med mar bsgom na/ padma'i sna rtser thig le bsgom/ 'di las bde nyams skye/ de nas thig le de lte bar drangs te bsgom/ der yang bde nyams skye na snying ga dang*/ der yang byung na mgrin pa dang*/ der yang byung na spyi bo dang*/ de la yang byung na smin phrag tu chos 'byung gru gsum gcig gi nang du thig le de bsgom/ de nas sna rtse'i nang du bsgom/ de nas sna rtse nas sor bzhi dang*/ de nas sor brgyad kyi nam mkha' la yang bsgom/ de nas ka bum lta bu gcig gi steng du thig le bsgom/ de nas yid kyi 'gyu ba thams cad dang thig le'i rnam pa bsres te bsgoms pas/

snang ba thams cad bde ba 'bar ba'i grogs su 'gro'o/ /'di don gyis na dgyes rdor lugs la rdzogs rim yin mod kyang*/ bskyed rim gyi cha lag yin pa'i phyir/ bskyed rim gyi phra thig ces bya ste/ 'di la dmigs skor bcu gnyis byung ba'o/ /phra mo'i man ngag haṃ yig kha sprod du grags pa zhig kyang yod de/ rdzogs rim dngos yin zhing*/ lam dgu skor dang 'brel bas 'dir ma bshad do/ /gsum pa ni/ skabs 'di'i phra thig la nyams myong skyes sam/ rdzogs rim gzhan la brten pa'i bde stong gi nyams myong shar yang rung ste/ bla ma dam pa'i cho ga sngon du song nas/ tshad med bzhi dang stong nyid sgom pa'i skabs/ sngar bsgom pa'i bde ba'i nyams de 'char thub pa zhig bya/ de'i snang cha yig 'bru phyag mtshan lha sku sogs su rim gyis skyes nas/ bde ba nyid lha sku/ lha sku nyid bde bar bsgom pa'o/ /'di la yang bslab tsam nyid nas zung 'jug tu shar na legs/ gal te ma shar na phra thig sogs la brten nas bde nyams bskyed/ de ma yal ba'i ngang nas/ lha skur dran tsam byed kyin lha sku la gtso bor sems bstad/ des bde nyams yal 'gro ba snyam byed na/ lha sku'i rnam pa ma shor bar byas nas/ sngar gyi bde ba bskyed thabs de bskyar nas bsgom/ de nas yang lha sku mi gsal du song na/ bde nyams de ka lha skur khrong gis byung bar mos/ de ltar phar ldog tshur ldog tu bsgoms pas zung 'jug tu 'gyur ro// zhe sdang bskyed rim dang bsre/ 'dod chags dbang dang bsre/ gti mug 'od gsal dang bsre zhes 'chad dgos pa dang*/ bskyed rim sgyu lus kyi rgyu grung po yin pas bsre bar bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la/ gtum mo dang*/ sgyu lus dang*/ 'od gsal gyi rdzogs rim gsum mo/ /dang po la rang lus thabs ldan la brten pa dang*/ gzhan lus shes rab la brten pa'o/ /dang po la/ rlung sems brid pa'i man ngag dang*/

gtum mo sgom pa dngos gnyis so/ /dang po ni yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la lus gnad legs par bcas/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ bla ma la mos gus dung ba bya/ rang lha skur gsal ba'i smin mtshams su/ rlung sems 'dres pa'i thig le dkar la zlum pa/ snum la 'tsher ba ril ril ba 'od 'phro ba che ba bsgom bde na che ba dang*/ chung ba bsgom bde na chung bar bsgom yang gsung*/ byi'u'i sgo nga tsam bsgom yang gsung ste/ bde mi bde la khyad cher med na phal cher sran ma'i 'bru tsam bsgom/ de yang res bsgrims shing yang yang gsal 'debs kyin bsgom/ res gsal 'debs thengs gcig gi 'phro la yun ring du lhod de bsgom/ dmigs pa gzhan gyi spros pa dor te bsgoms pas/ rab tu reg mthong gi mtshan ma rnyed/ de min na'ang smin mtshams su 'dus pa snyam byed pa dang*/ 'bugs pa snyam byed pa dang*/ tsha breng breng ba 'byung ngo*/ /dmigs skor gcig go /de nas dpral ba'i thig le de gyen segs la ri li li 'gril te spyi bo tshangs bug gi thad du sleb nas/ dar cig skya ril le 'dug /bde ba yid la bya/ yang tshur 'ongs te smin mtshams su sleb/ yang de ma thag sngar bzhin song ste/ spyi bor sleb par bsam/ de ltar yang yang bsgom/ dmigs skor gnyis/ de nas lus kyi dbus su rtsa a wa dhu tī kha dog dmar po sbubs stong mda' smyug 'bring po tsam yang sna tshangs bug la thug cing*/ tshangs bug nas rgyu zhabs kyi bar du drang thang nge ba de nas tshur 'khyogs te rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo sleb pa zhig bsgom ste dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ /yang rtsa dbu ma de dang smin mtshams kyi thig le sngar bzhin bsgoms nas/ thig le de yar ri li li song*/ tshangs bug gi thad dbu ma'i steng du sleb/ der bag tsam zhig skya ril le bde ye re 'dug /de nas thig le de rtsa a wa dhu tī'i nang nas mar bskyur bas sgra cong cong ba'am/

'ur 'ur ba'am/ chil chil ba sgra cher byung bar bsams la/ thig le de nor bu'i nang na skya ril le 'dug pa la sems bstad/ dar cig song nas thig le de dbu ma'i nang nas yar mgyogs par song ste/ tshangs bug gi thad dbu ma'i steng du sngar bzhin 'dug par bsam/ yang dbu ma'i nang du lhung ba sogs skyar gyin yang yang sgom/ dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /dmigs pa cung zad goms nas sngon 'gro'i skabs kyi rlung sbyor dang bstun nas bsgom na bzang*/ dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /'dir dmigs pa'i rnam grangs gcig la/ thig le babs pas dbu ma'i mas sna thig les gang ba'am/ dbu ma phal cher gang ba'am/ dbu ma'i nang du thig le ba thag lta bur breng nge bsgom pa'ang bshad mod kyi/ lag len ni snga ma kho na'o/ /'di bsgoms pas bde stong gi nyams shig nges par skyes/ 'on kyang rtsal chen po ma byung na/ thun dang po la smin phrag gi thig le bsgom/ thun gnyis pa la tshangs bug tu thig le bsgom/ thun gsum pa la rtsa a wa dhū tī bsgoms/ thun bzhi pa la sngar bzhin spyi bo'i thig le lhung ba sogs bsgom pas/ zhag shas na bogs shig thon 'ong*/ des kyang ma byung na yang sngar bzhin smin mtshams kyi thig le 'bab zhig zhag shas bsgom/ rnam grangs kyi 'dam kha'i dmigs pa gcig la/ thig le 'di rus pa'i chos 'byung gcig gi nang du bsgom zer ba'ang yod de/ rus pa dngos su bsgom pa min dkar po'i don yin/ de nas smin mtshams kyi thig le gyen la 'gril nas spyi bor sleb pa kho na yang yang bsgom/ spyi bo nas smin mtshams su ldog pa mi byed/ de 'dra thun gcig gam gnyis bsgom/ de nas rtsa a wa dhu tī lug rjud kyi rgyu ma lta bu snyang snying 'dab 'dob cig bsgom pa la thun gcig gam gnyis/ de nas thig le dbu ma'i nang du babs pas/ thig le ga ru sleb sleb tu rgyu ma phus btab pa ltar/ ltang ltang khengs/ bde ba khril khril skyes/

dbu ma'i mas sna nas rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor dkar rtser gyis sleb par bsam/ yang yar song ba sogs sngar dang 'dra/ 'dis bde la mi rtog pa'i nyams khyad par can mi skye mi srid do/ /de ltar na spogs pa'i cho ga gnyis yin/ bde stong gi nyams skyes nas kyang brtan pa thob pa'i phyir bsgom dgos/ brtan po 'dug na snang ba dang bsre ste/ gong phra thig gi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa la rtsa ba'i man ngag dang*/ rnam grangs kyi man ngag bde ba bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la a thung gi gdams ngag dang*/ 'bar 'dzag bsdus pa la bslab pa dang*/ 'bar 'dzag rgyas pa la bslab pa ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ sngon du rlung bum can zhag shas sbyangs te spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de nas rlung sbyor de la slob bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ yan lag lnga sbyongs sam/ drug skor ram/ lus sbyong gzhan yang rung ste/ zla ba phyed dam/ zla ba gcig la sogs pa lus sbyongs la shugs je cher bslab bo/ /de ltar rlung dang lus 'byongs nas dngos gzhi dmigs pa nyams su len pa'i skabs/ thun kyi dus su lus gnad bcas te/ dmigs pa dang bum can sbrags pa nyid bsgom/ thun mtshams su lus sbyongs ci rigs pa 'grub na bzang*/ ha cang mang na ngal dub tu song ste/ dngos gzhi'i nyams la gnod pa yang srid pas ran tsam bya/ gtum mo'i skabs 'di dag tu/ dus kyi gnad/ yul gyi gnad/ lus kyi gnad/ sems gtod sa/ dmigs lugs kyi gnad de bzhi tshang ba zha

ི ga dgos par bzhed/ dang po ni/ rlung dbu mar 'bab pa'i dus de/ de'i rtags sna sgo nas mnyam rgyu 'bab pa yin gsung*/ 'on kyang rlung sbyang ba sngon du song ba'i gang zag la/ bum can drag po lan 'ga' yar bsgoms pas ka mnyam rgyur 'gro/ mnyam rgyu rang bzhin pa sgug dgos nas sgom pa'i dus tsam mi yong ngo*/ /des na khams bzang na srod tho rangs snga dgongs te thun bzhir bsgom/ ngan na snga dro phyi dro thun gnyis la bsgom mo/ / lus gnad ni/ re mig ltar bsnol/ rgya mdud ltar bsdam/ mda' ltar bsrangs/ lcags kyu ltar dgug li ri ltar sgrim/ zhes pa ste/ /'on kyang khrag mkhris shas che na rkang pa skyil krung nyid mchog yin/ grang rlung shas che na tsog pu bya ste/ bsam gtan 'bol chung gi steng du 'phongs tshos bzhag /rkang mthil 'bol chung gi mdun du 'ong bar byas nas/ rkang pa re mig ltar bsnol ba la pus 'khyud kyis bsdams/ lag pa mnyam bzhag lte 'og tu brten/ sgal tshigs bsrangs/ mgrin pa dgug /nya bzhi sgrim pa'o/ /yul gyi gnad ni/ lus la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi sogs go ba chags nges zhig byas nas/ rang rang gi gang skabs su bab pa'i sa der/ dmigs pa gtod sa ma 'khrul ba dgos pa'o/ / dmigs lugs kyi gnad ni so so'i dmigs pa ma nor bar byed pa ste/ de la a thung gi skabs 'dir/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems mos gus gsum/ dngos gzhi lus yi dam lhar dran tsam byas la/ rlung ro bsal/ rlung bum can bzung*/ rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan gyi nang lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad na/ gtum mo'i me a shad kyi rnam pa can mtshon gang ba zhig la/ me lce lhag ge 'bar ba/ me lce'i rtse mo lte bar sleb pa zhig bsgom/ 'di kho nas ye shes skye ba'i phyir/ /dmigs pa nyung la gnad che ba yin no/ lag len dmigs pa 'di kho na la byed/ rnams grangs su gtum mo'i me la dmigs tshul mi 'dra ba yang*/ /me stag can dang*/

khab lta bu dang*/ me lce gsum pa dang*/ me lces snying gar sleb pa sogs 'dam kha dang*/ thig le nya gang ba la dmigs pa zhes pa/ me'i tshab tu thig le skya khyil le bsgom pa yang yod/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i don bsgom zer nas/ dmigs pa logs par byed pa'ang yod mod kyi/ lag len la a thung dang sbrel nas bsgom ste/ de yang sngar gyi gtum mo a thung de/ zla gcig tsam zhig 'bad pas bsgom/ dmigs skor gcig go /des 'dod chags chen po'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba/ sgom stobs kyis bde ba zha ི ga nges par skye/ de nas brtsams te rlung thengs bzhi tsam re gtum mo a thung rang bsgom/ de rjes rlung sems dbu mar chud snyam pa byas nas/ rlung thengs bzhi tsam re gang yang yid la mi byed par bzhagakhams ngan na srod dang tho rangs kyi thun la rlung rtsol mi byed par/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa dang mi rtog pa spel gyin bsgom mo/ /dmigs skor gnyis so/ /de ltar sgoms pas/ du ba la sogs pa'i rtags lnga rim gyis 'byung*/ rjes thob kyi snang ba thams cad la yang bde stong dbyer med kyi nyams rim pas skye/ mthar smig sgyu sogs rtags lnga pa rdzogs pa dang*/ rjes thob tu yul snang sgyu ma lta bur 'char/ mnyam bzhag tu yul snang rang log tu 'gro/ thun thun mtshams thams cad du bde stong gi nyams la gsal 'grib med/ zas gos kyi ltos pa las grol/ dug dang mtshon gyis mi tshugs/ yon tan brgyad kyi phan yon 'byung*/ sku'i sgo dgu 'gag /gsung gi sgo bzhi bcom/ thugs kyi sgo gnyis 'byed/ snying ga dang smin mtshams nas/ rtsa thams cad 'dus pa'i rtsa sna re yod pa de kha bye bas yon tan phyogs med du 'char ro/ /de nas drod thob pa yin pas lung bstan byung na/ rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad de nye rgyus 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor ba yin/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa de tsam du zad/ lugs 'di'i bla ma gong ma rnams spyod pa zla ba gsum/

sgrub pa zhag bdun/ ma grub na lha gnad la bor nas sgrub pa skyar ma byed/ ces gsung ngo*/ /de ltar bshad zin pa'i mi rtog pa'i gtum mo bsgom pa nas brtsams te/ yon tan skye tshul rnams dmigs pa'i gtso bo thams cad la 'di kho nas rigs 'gre'o/ /de ni gtum mo'i dmigs pa dang po a thung gi 'khrid ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa gtum mo 'bar 'dzag bsdus pa ni/ gzhan bya ba byed tshul thams cad snga ma dang 'dra ba las lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar po/ yas sna spyi bo dang*/ mas sna lte 'og sor bzhir zug pa/ yas sna la spyi bo'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsa 'dab brgyad pa de'i lte ba dbu ma'i yas sna phug pa/ de'i steng du haṃ dkar po la mgo bo thur du blta ba yod pa'i/ haṃ gi mgo bo dbu ma'i yas snar chud tsam/ de'i mtha' skor dang rtsa 'dab rnams la byang chub kyi sems chab bros chags pa ltar skya khrom me sgom/ yang dmigs pa shin du 'khob chung na spyi bo'i haṃ dang dbu ma ma gtogs rtsa 'khor ma bsgoms kyang chog gsungs*/ lte 'og sor bzhi na gdan thig le dmar po zhig gi steng du/ gtum mo'i me mar me bzang ba tsam zhig gi me lce'i rtse mo dbu ma'i nang du chud pa tsam zhig dmar skyem skyem 'bar zhing cung zad g.yo bar bsgom/ de nas rlung bum pa can gzung bas/ steng 'og gi rlung lte 'og tu 'dres pa des bskul nas me lce'i rtse mo las me phra mo rta rnga tsam zha ི ga dbu ma'i nang nas yar 'bar/ je ring je ring la song nas spyi bo'i haṃ la reg reg 'dug /de nas haṃ las thig le khu 'phangs lta bu skya khro lo lo babs pas/ me lce phra mo 'bar ba de mar la rdogs/ thig le rnams lte 'og gi me la tim tim thim pas/ bde ba lhang lhang skye bar mos/ rlung thengs gsum gsum bzhi bzhi la dmigs pa de nyid bskyar gyin skyar gyin bsgom/ thun re'i nang du ma mthar yang lan nyer gcig tsam re bsgoms na nyams myong myur du skye bar 'gyur ro/

/dmigs skor gcig gal te 'dis nyams myong ma skyes na/ me lce phra mo haṃ la reg pa'i bar sngar bzhin bsgom/ haṃ las thi le dkar na ra ra babs pas/ me lce phra mo je thung je thung la lte ba'i me la 'dus shing thig le yang me la sib sib thim/ bde ba skyes par mos te rlung thengs gcig gnyis song ba na/ lte 'og gi me'i dbus nas me phra mo rlung shugs can sgra dang bcas pa byung nas/ thig le'i rgyun gyen la slog te/ skya yer re re yar song spyi bo'i haṃ la thim/ rlung thengs gcig tsam dar cig de la sems bstad/ yang me lce ldog thig le sngar bzhin babs par bsgom pa ste/ 'dis bde stong gi nyams la bogs thon/ bying ba sel lo/ /de ltar zla gcig sogs bsgom dmigs skor gnyis so/ /mi rtog pa dang bsre tshul sogs gong bzhin no/ /gsum pa 'bar 'dzag rgyas pa la bslab pa ni/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa gsum spyi dang 'dra/ rtsa 'khor bzhi la spyi bo dkar po/ mgrin pa dmar po/ snying ga sngon po/ lte ba dmar po'am sna tshogs so/ /lte 'og sor bzhir gtum mo sngar bzhin/ lte ba'i 'khor lo'i nang gi dbu mar lte 'og gi me lce'i rtse mo sleb par bsam/ 'dab ma brgyad la a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha /snying ga'i dbus su hūṃ/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la/ bruṃ aṃ dzriṃ khaṃ mgrin pa'i dbus su oṃ/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la/ laṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ bzhi'am/ moṃ deṃ maṃ raṃ bzhi bsgoms kyang rung*/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo dang haṃ yig gong bzhin bsgom/ rlung bum pa can kha sbyor du bzung*/ lte 'og gi me las me lce rta rnga tsam 'bar/ snying ga dang mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor thams cad me 'od kyis khyab/ me lce spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas/ haṃ las thig le rta rnga dkar po'i rgyun tsam na ra ra 'bab pa'am/ khu 'phangs ltar khro lo lo 'bab pa 'dam kha yin/ thig le babs pa na me lce phra mo de mar ldog /thig le lte ba'i a thung la thim pa sogs gong bzhin brgyud pa 'di'i lugs la me lces snying ga'i hūṃ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ phug pa sogs mi bzhed do/

/gnyis pa bde ba bskyed byed kyi rnam grangs la/ haṃ yig mdud pa can gyis dbab pa/ haṃ yig bcu drug gi dbab pa/ phra mos dbab pa/ rlung drod kyi thig les dbab pa/ rgyal mtshan mtshon bsnun gyis dbab pa/ rdo rje sems dpas dbab pa rnams so/ /dang po ni/ rang gi lte bar nyi ma'i steng du a dmar po/ spyi bo'i haṃ las haṃ dkar po thig le ba thag lta bu'i sne la 'byar ba zhig chad/ sor lnga drug re nas haṃ 'khor bas ba thag la mdud pa'am/ 'khril bar 'dra ba re byung*/ de 'dra ba'i mdud pa bdun tsam byung na lte ba'i a la reg reg 'dug pas/ lus bde khril khril byung bar mos/ yang yar la ldog ste haṃ gi skor ldog byas pas/ mdud pa gcig zhig /thur la nar tsam babs/ ba thag je thung la yar yer song*/ yang mdud pa gcig zhig /thur la nar tsam babs rjes ba thag thung du song bas yar yer yer 'gro ba sogs la dmigs nas/ mdud pa bdun rdzogs pa na/ spyi bo'i haṃ la thim/ de lta bu yang yang bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyi bo'i dbus su chos 'byung dkar po kha thur bstan zhig bsgom/ de'i nang du haṃ bcu drug khog stong mgo bo phyir thur segs la bstan/ zhabs nang bstan gyen segs la yod pa sbu gu can te/ thams cad 'dzam pa'i dbus su haṃ mgo bo thur bstan zhig bsgom/ dbus kyi haṃ las thig le 'o ma'i rgyun ltar nar gyis babs/ haṃ yig bcu drug gi zhabs nas song*/ khong stong rnams bdud rtsis mer gyis khengs par bsam/ de rnams las babs pa'i bdud rtsi'i char zim lta bu thim thim 'bab pa la sems bstad do/ /gsum pa ni/ lte 'og sor bzhir haṃ dmar po gang la'ang ma reg pa zha ི ga /spyi bor haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur bstan no/ /rlung phyir 'gro ba'i dus lte 'og sor bzhi'i haṃ dmar po las me lce phra zhing ser ba zha ི ga sir gyis 'bar nas/ spyi bo'i haṃ dkar po phug /rlung nang du yong ba dang bstun/

spyi bo'i haṃ las thig le dkar po phra na ra ra babs te me lce ded de haṃ dmar po la thug gi btang*/ yang lte 'og gi haṃ gi me lces thig le dkar po yar ded de/ spyi bo'i haṃ la thug pa sogs yar ded mar ded kho na la sems bstad do/ /bzhi pa ni/ rlung phyir bsal ba'i skabs/ lte ba nas rlung shin du tsha ba zhig 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pas lam te byung*/ lus thams cad khyab/ rtsa nang thams cad dros shing zhu/ rlung nang du rngubs te lte 'og tu bsdigs pas/ stod smad bar gsum gyi rtsa thams cad nas thig le'i rgyun phra mo babs te/ lte 'og sor bzhir 'dus te khyi li li 'dug par bsam pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ rdo rje'i lte bar phaṭa nag po zhig bsam/ de las me dmar nag 'bar bas rdo rje'i nang khengs/ lte 'og na rtsa klu dbang 'khyil pa sbrul 'khyil pa lta bur yod pa'i nang du zhugs/ skor ba rim pa bdun gyi nang brgyud nas/ steng gi bu ga nas thon spyi bo'i haṃ la reg /byang chub kyi sems zhu/ me lce mar babs pa dang lhan cig /klu dbang 'khyil ba'i steng sgo nas zhugs/ sbugs 'ded rgyud de thur bltas kyi sgo nas thon/ yar mar babs te gsang ba'i rdo rje thig les mer te khengs par bsam dmigs pa de nyid yang yang bskyar te bsgom pa yin/ drug pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka yab yum kha sbyor ram/ yab rkyang yang rung*/ zhabs g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa gcig bsgom gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su hūṃ/ de las 'od zer bde drod kyi rang bzhin can steng du 'phros/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku la thim/ bde ba rgyas nas kha sbyor yin na sbyor mtshams nas thig le'i rgyun 'bab ba dang*/ gtso rkyang yin na zhabs kyi mthe bong nas 'beb gsung yang*/ sku'i cha thams cad nas babs pas chog /gang ltar yang thig le'i rgyun gyis lus nang thams cad khengs par bsam mo/

/de ltar na bde ba dbab thabs drug po 'di/ nā ro pa dang*/ thar pa'i lam ston gnyis kyi man ngag gung spros pa yin zer ba'ang yig rnying 'ga' re na snang ngo*/ /gnyis pa gzhan lus shes rab kyi man ngag la/ sngon 'gro ni spyi gong dang 'dra ba las/ rang lus thabs ldan la brten nas/ rlung dang gtum mo cung zad goms par byas na bzang ngo*/ /lam dngos la phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid brtag pa/ sngags dang rdzas kyis dgug pa/ mi snang bar sba ba/ 'khor ba'i skye rgyun bcad pa/ lus zungs rgyas par bya ba/ phyag rgya sgyu mar sbyang ba ste sbyor ba'i chos drug /rtsa btsal ba/ bde ba dbab pa/ bde ba 'dzin pa/ thig le bzlog pa/ rtsa mig tu gdab pa/ ye shes chen por bskyal ba ste/ dngos gzhi'i chos drug /yul dang*/ dus dang*/ lus kyi gnad gsum 'dzom pas sgrub ste/ pho nya'i lam mo/ /yang rtsis mgo bcu'am bco lnga'i sgo nas 'chad pa'ang yod de/ sa bcad mang nyung tsam ma gtogs don la lhag chad med do/ /'dir sa bcad tsam ston/ man ngag ni logs su ston gyi dkyus su mi 'chad do/ /gnyis pa sgyu lus kyi man ngag la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum zhes 'chad pa'ang yod mod/ sngon 'gro gong du bstan pa nyid yin gyi logs su med pas 'dir 'di skad ces bya ste/ nyams myong ma skyes pa skyed pa rmi lam sgyu ma dang*/ skyes pa brtan rgyas su byed pa sad bar gyi sgyu ma'o/ /dang po la/ 'dun pa rgyun chags su sbyang ba/ rmi lam gsal snang sgrub pa/ rmi lam ngo shes skyong tshul/ rtsal sbyong spel sogs la bslab pa/ rmi lam dag par sbyong ba ste lnga'o/ /dang po ni dmigs chen gcig yin yang*/ dmigs skor gsum du bya ste/ thun gyi sngon 'gro rnams sngar bzhin byas nas/ rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad la gzhig 'brel zhig bcug ste/ snang ba sna tshogs pa 'di dag thams cad rang gi sems kyi snang ba tsam ma gtogs/ dngos gnas la cung zad kyang grub pa med pas/

sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /thams cad sems snang yin yang*/ phyi don rgyang chad du snang bas/ snang ba 'di thams cad dngos gnas la ma grub pa'i 'khrul snang yin tsa na/ 'khrul snang de 'dzin zhing gang la snang ba'i nang shes rig 'di yang 'khrul snang de la bltos pa yin pa'i phyir/ bden dngos su ga la yod/ 'di dag thams cad kyang 'ja' tshon ltar rten 'brel tshogs pa'i snang ba tsam yin gnas tshul la cung zad kyang ma grub bo zhes 'dun pa drag po sbyangs/ yang de ka la ngal gso'i tshul du rig pa rang sor bzhagatshul de bskyar gyin rtag tu bsgom pa ste dmigs skor dang po'o/ /yang de ka sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ da lta'i snang ba 'di dang rmi lam la khyad par med/ nyams su ni gnyis ka myong*/ don la ni gnyis ka med/ des kha sang phan chad kyi na tsha sdug bsngal dang*/ mdang rmi lam du na tsha sdug bsngal 'byung ba gnyis la/ de ring gi dus na khyad par cung zad kyang mi 'dug kha sang phan chad bza' btung dga' ston byas pa dang*/ mdang rmi lam du dga' ston byas pa gnyis kyang*/ de ring gi dus na khyad cung zad kyang mi 'dug /sad pa rnams sad pa'i dus dang*/ rmi lam rnams rmi lam gyi dus na/ snang ba shar mnyam/ bde sdug myong mnyam du byung*/ de ring gi dus na rmi lam de gang na'ang mi 'dug pa bzhin du/ kha sang phan chad byung ba'i sad dus kyi snang ba thams cad kyang*/ de ring gang na'ang mi 'dug pa dang 'dra/ rmi lam dang da lta'i snang ba la khyad par cung zad kyang med/ bden par grub par mi 'dug ang snyam du bsgom/ dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ /yang 'dun pa de gnyis 'brel chags su bsgom pa'i rjes su/ der ma zad rang dang gdong du snang ba 'di thams cad rmi lam rang yin pa 'dug snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po sbyong ste dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ /

gnyis pa ni lus gnad bcos/ rang gi mgrin par rtsa 'khor lo 'dab bzhi'am/ de nyid pad ma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i rnam par sgoms kyang rung*/ rtsa 'khor ram/ padma'i lte ba la oṃ dmar po/ 'dab ma bzhi la mdun ma la a/ g.yas pa la nu/ rgyab ma la ta/ g.yon pa la ra ste thams cad kha dog dmar por bsgom/ kha cig phyogs mdog sgom par 'dod pa'ang yod pa/ spyir 'gog pa min te/ 'dir mi mdzad par gda' zhing*/ kha dog 'dra bar byed pa 'di ka sgoms stabs bde'o/ / 'dab ma bzhi'i yi ge la dum tsam dum tsam re sems gtod/ dbus kyi oṃ la yun ring ba re sems 'jog /dmigs skor gcig go /de ltar zhag shas song nas/ yi ge rnams la sems gtod pa'i skabs su/ do nub cis kyang rmi lam rmi ba zhig dgos/ de yang mang po rmi ba/ gsal po rmi ba/ bzang bo rmi ba gcig bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang gtong ngo*/ /gnyis pa'o/ /de lta bu zhag shas bsgom pas/ rmi lam mang zhing gsal ba gcig tu 'gyur 'ong*/ gal te ma 'gyur na dmigs pa de kho na bsgoms nas/ rlung bum can la gnad du bsnun pas/ de ma thag tu 'gyur 'ong*/ dmigs skor gsum pa ste de rnams dmigs chen gcig yin/ 'di la rmi lam rmi bar byed pa'i gdams ngag ces gsungs te/ de'i go don tha mal gyi rmi lam 'di la ni zin 'byongs dkon zhing*/ bag re tsam byung yang*/ nyams myong 'gang che ba tsam mi yong*/ rlung sems la gnad du bsnun pa'i mthu las byung ba'i gnyid dang rmi lam gsal po de la ni yon tan skye ba yin pas/ de lta bu'i rmi lam rmi ba'i thabs yin zhes pa'o/ /yang mgrin pa'i a nu ta ra'i tshab la/ smin mtshams su chos 'byung dkar po mtshon gang ba gcig gi nang du/ thig le dkar po sran ma tsam 'od 'tsher ba gcig la sems bstad/ 'di la'ang dmigs skor gsum du bya tshul snga mas rigs 'gre'o/ /rngaug pa'i yig rnying rnams na/ sngar gyi a nu ta ra las 'di la bsngags pa che bar mdzad do/

/gsum pa ni/ dmigs pa snga ma de bsgoms pas rlung dwangs te rmi lam gsal la mang ba rtag par yong*/ de byung ba na yang sngar bzhin mgrin pa'i oṃ yig a nu ta ra dang bcas pa gsal btab/ do nub cis kyang rmi lam zin par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang bcas/ 'dab ma'i yi ge bzhi la rim pas/ yud re yud re sems bstad/ dbus kyi oṃ la rig pa bstad de 'dun pa drag tu sbyong ba yun ring du bya'o/ /thun mtshams thams cad du yang rmi lam yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu bya'o/ /nyal ba'i skabs/ dang por a la sems 'dzin/ gnyid 'byung tshang pa la nu dang*/ cung zad srib pa na ta dang*/ hūṃ gi 'gro ba na ra dang*/ gnyid dngos la thib kyi song ba na oṃ la sems 'dzin zhes bshad pa byed kyang*/ lag len la 'gor 'gro bas/ thog ma gnyid du mi 'gro ba'i dus nyid nas/ yi ge bzhi la rim can du sems bstad de/ mthar oṃ la sems bstad pa'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro ba kho nas chog gsungs/ de skabs kyang rmi lam zin par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa mi drag tsam sbyangs bas nges par zin par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'dun pa de nyid rgyun du sbyongs pas/ rmi lam phal cher rmi lam du ngo shes par 'byung ste dmigs skor gcig go /yang nyin par mgrin pa'i 'khor lo sngar bzhin bsgoms nas/ do nub rmi lam mang po rmi gsal po rmi/ bzang po rmi bar bya/ rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes pa zhig bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po btang*/ mgrin pa'i oṃ yig la sems bstad pa'i ngang nas sngar bzhin bsgom/ dmigs bskor gnyis so/ /de nas yang*/ snang ba thams cad rang sems las gzhan du med/ bden par ma grub/ sad dus kyi snang ba rags pa dang*/ rmi lam zhes bya ba la yang khyad par mi 'dug snyam pa'i ngang nas sems la che re blta lhod kyis bzhag /yang mgrin pa'i oṃ yig lam gyis dran pa dang*/ snang yang bden pas stong pa'i 'dun pa dung tsam zhig bya/

dmigs skor gsum mo/ /de nyid yang nas yang du sgom/ de ltar sgoms pas/ dang por rmi lam gsal po zhig rmi/ de rmi lam du shes/ de nas bden med kyi 'dun pa rang shugs su 'byung bas rkyen byas te/ rmi lam gyi snang ba yang ma yal ba la/ sems bde stong du lhan ne gnas pa zhig 'byung*/ 'di rmi lam gyi dge sbyor dngos gzhi yin/ 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i spel sbyang gnyis 'di'i yan lag yin gsung ngo*/ /yang gong du smin mtshams kyi thig le la dmigs pa sbyangs pa yin na/ skabs 'dir yang mgrin par yi ge lnga sgom pa'i dod smin mtshams kyi thig le la byas te 'dun pa ni sngar bzhin skyong ba yin/ des na 'di la'ang dmigs skor gsum dang*/ rmi lam la rmi lam du shes par byed pa dang*/ rmi lam gyi rang bzhin shes par byed pa gnyis yod do/ /'di dag la'ang yun ring rab bsgoms kyang*/ rmi lam mi zin pa dang*/ rmi lam zin yang dge sbyor mi sleb pa'i rigs la/ rlung bum can 'dzin zha ི nga*/ bden med kyi 'dun pa de shugs che la yun ring du sbyong ba gal che'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sngar bzhin mgrin pa'i yi ge lnga'am/ smin mtshams kyi thig le la sems gtod pa gang rung gcig bsgom pa'i ngang nas/ rmi lam yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs/ rang gi mdun na yod pa'i snod bcud kyi dngos po zhig la dmigs/ mang por spel ba'i rjes su gcig tu bsdu ba'am/ chen por rgya bskyed cing chu ngur bsdu ba sogs la bslab/ dmigs skor gcig /yang bden med du shes pa'i sgo nas/ me chu g.yang sa sogs 'jigs skrag skye ba dang*/ skyug bro ngo tsha sogs la thog rdzis kyi dmigs pa byed/ ri rab sogs thogs bcas la thogs med du sbyong ngo*/ /dmigs skor gnyis/ yang sgyu ma'i 'dun pa dang bcas bzhin pas/ nyi zla'i 'od zer la 'jus nas sum cu rtsa gsum sogs blta/ dga' ldan du phyin nas byams pa la chos nyan/

yi dam gyi lha'i zhal blta/ bla ma dang mkha' 'gro sogs dang mjal nas dbang bskur zhu/ nam mkha' la 'phur/ sa 'og tu 'dzul/ stod nas me 'bar ba dang*/ smad nas chu 'brub pa sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa bya/ de lta bu bsgom yang bsgom mo/ /dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ /de gsum char la yang*/ thog mar mgrin pa'i smin mtshams su sems bstad/ snang ba 'di la bden med dang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa sbyangs de nas so so'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ do nub rmi lam du'ang 'di ltar bya'o snyam pa de bstar chags su bsgom dgos pa yin/ nyin par de ltar bsgoms pas mtshan mo rang shugs su 'byung ngo*/ /lnga pa ni/ yang nyin par sngar bzhin/ mgrin pa'i yi ge lnga dang*/ dpral ba'i thig le gang rung la sems bstad/ bden med dang*/ rmi lam yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po sbyangs de ka'i ngang la dmigs par cung zad bzhag /de ma thag rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad dgyes pa rdo rje'am/ bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor du phra gsal gyis bsgom bden med dang*/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa yud tsam sbyangs/ nyin par de lta bu yang yang bsgoms pas mtshan mo rmi lam du'ang 'byung ste/ dang por lha sku shar/ de bden med du shes pas bde ba rang shugs su rnyed de/ lha sku gsal stong bde ba'i ngang las ma g.yos pa zhig 'byung ngo*/ /'dis rmi lam gyi dge sbyor mthar phyin pa'o/ /dgyes rdor bsre 'pho 'di la sgyu lus kyi gdams ngag gi rtsa ba rmi lam yin par mdzad do/ /las dang po pa gcig la sad dus kyi sgyu ma'i nyams myong de/ glo bur btsan thabs su skye dka' bas/ sad dus rang la dang por gnad du bsnun dgos na/ sgyu ma lta bu las gtum mo kho na gnad du che/ 'on kyang rmi lam gyi gdams ngag las ni/ las dang po pa la'ang 'phral du nyams myong skye thub/ de byung na sad dus kyi sgyu ma'i nyams myong skye ba la yang tshegs med pas rmi lam gyi gseng lam la phyin na sad dus kyi sgyu lus la tshegs med do/

/des na sad dus dang bar do sgyu ma'i rtsa ba rmi lam sgyu ma la thugalugs 'di'i rgyud bshad kyi skabs na yang*/ lte bar gtum mo/ snying gar 'od gsal/ mgrin par sgyu lus/ spyi bor las rgya ste/ 'khor lo bzhi la lam bzhi sbyor ba'i skabs/ sgyu lus kyi gdams ngag mgrin par gnad du bsnun gsung ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin no/ /lugs gzhan la 'chad tshul gzhan yang yod de 'dir ma smos so/ /gnyis pa nyams myong skyes pa brtan rgyas su byed pa la/ snang ba sgyu ma dang*/ bar do sgyu ma gnyis so/ /dang po la/ dngos dang bogs 'don gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnyid sad dus kyi sgom yin te/ dbang po rnon po zhig la rmi lam zin pa dang 'byongs pa na sad dus kyi sgom rang shugs kyi 'byung ba zhig kyang yod/ dbang po 'bring la rmi lam gyi nyams des da lta'i snang ba la rgyas btab pa tsam gyis 'char thub pa zha ི ga kyang yod mod/ 'dir dbang po tha ma zhigarmi lam dag par 'byongs na rab yin/ min na yang rmi lam zin zha ི nga der sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams skyong thub kyin yod na/ nyin par yang 'di ltar bsgom ste/ sngon 'gro rnams gong ltar btang*/ sngar bzhin mgrin pa'i oṃ yig la sems cung zad bstad de/ rang gzhan snod bcud 'di dag snang la rang bzhin med pa rmi lam lta bu'o/ /zhes rmi lam gyi nyams myong dran pa dang bsres te cung zad bzhag /de yang yang bsgom ste dmigs skor gcig /yang de'i 'phros la snang ba thams cad nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du song*/ gang yang bsam du med par 'jog pa yang yang bsgom dmigs skor gnyis/ yang bden med kyi 'dun pa dang mi rtog pa de kha bzhin sngon du btang nas stong pa'i ngang las/ rang dgyes rdor ram bdag med ma'i skur wal gyis bsgom/ snod bcud thams cad lha dang gzhal yas khang du bsam/ dmig skor gsum/ lhar shar tsa na sgyu ma yang rang shar du shar na des chog /de min dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo de la yang sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun pa sbyangs/

dmigs skor bzhi/ thun mtshams thams cad du yang lha sku dang sgyu ma'i 'dun pa sbyong*/ dmigs skor lnga ste dmigs chen gcig las phye ba'i dmigs skor lnga'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas rang gi mdun du me long bzhagarang gi gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ skye bo mang pos bstod pa dang mchod par bsam/ gzugs brnyan la dga' sems med/ smod cing brdeg 'tshog byed par bsam/ gzugs brnyan la zhe sdang med/ thams cad 'di lta bu'o snyam du bsam/ dmigs skor gcig de rang dang me long gi bar du bton nas sgom ste/ dmigs skor gnyis/ rang la'ang de bzhin du bsgom ste dmigs skor gsum/ de bzhin du yi dam gyi bris sku 'gying log gi gzugs brnyan me long la shar bar byas te bsgom pa sogs la'ang gsum ste/ dmigs skor drug po de rnams bogs 'don no/ /rmi lam dang gnyid sad kyi sgyu ma de yan chad brtson 'grus can tshe 'dir sangs rgya ba'i lam dngos yin/ de yang gtum mo dang rmi lam gnyis kar bsgom pas/ gnyis ka la nyams myong skyes na rab yin/ da dung gnyis ka bsgom zhing nyams skyong*/ gang rung zha ི ga kho na la skyes na'ang*/ de ka la bsgril te sgoms pas chog /gang la yin yang rung*/ rab tu mnyam rjes med pa zhig dgos te/ deng sang gi gang zag la de yang dkon/ mnyam bzhag gi sgom zhig la med thabs med/ de yod pas kyang 'chi ba bar do kun la bsre thub par 'ong ngo*/ /gnyis pa bar do sgyu ma'i man ngag la/ bar do dang po 'chi ba 'od gsal la brten nas chos sku ngos bzung ba dang gcig /'di tshe 'dir sangs rgya ba'i phyogs su gtogs gsungs te bar do ka gtso che/ bar do gnyis pa sgyu lus la brten nas zung 'jug gi sku ngos bzung ba dang gnyis/ bar do gsum pa 'gro drug gi skye sgo dgag pa dang gsum/ de gnyis bar dor sangs rgyas ba'i gdams ngag dngos yin/ 'phros don la bzhi pa skye sgo ma khegs na skye gnas 'dam du yod pa'i gdams ngag dang bzhi'o/

/de yang rtsa ba'i yi ge rnams las/ rmi lam sgyu ma'am/ gtum mo'i nyams myong cung zad yod pa zhig yin na/ 'chi kha kho nar bsgom pa 'dra ba zhig bshad kyang*/ da lta rang nas ma sbyangs na/ gdeng khel mi yong bas sbyong dgos/ dang po ni/ sngon 'gro snga ma ltar sbyangs/ nam zhig bdag 'chi ba'i tshe/ 'chi ba chos kyi skur lam du 'khyer dgos/ de yang 'di ltar sgom pa yin snyam/ 'chi ba lam khyer yin no bar shes pa'i 'dun pa de/ dmigs pa'i seb la bstar chags su yong bar byas nas rang gi lte 'og sor bzhi rtsa mdud gru gsum chos 'byung dmar por gyur pa'i nang du/ rtsa padma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i lte bar a shad dmar po gcig /'dab ma bzhi la/ a nu ta ra bzhi yang dmar por bsgom/ dmigs gnad dang pa'o/ /nam zhig sa chu la thim dus/ lus kyi zungs mi thub/ sa la bying ba'am gzhan gyis mnan pa snyam byed/ sprin lta bu lang long gi nyams 'byung ba yin pa 'dug snyam/ mdun gyi a la shes pa bstad/ gnad gnyis pa'o/ /a de g.yas kyi nu la thim/ nam zhig chu me la thim pa na/ lus grang ba dang 'dar ba'i rnam pa 'byung*/ snang grag gi chos rnams du ba lta bur yul yul po'i nyams 'char ro snyam g.yas kyi nu la shes pa bstad/ gnad gsum pa'o/ /de rjes nu yang rgyab kyi ta la thim/ nam zhig me rlung la thim pa na/ thog mar tshad dugs che zhing*/ phyi nas tshad pa yal/ rang gi sems me khyer lta bu gsal hrig tsam 'byung snyam du rgyab kyi ta la sems bstad/ gnad bzhi pa'o/ / de nas ta yang g.yon gyi ra la thim/ nam zhig rlung rnam shes la thim pa na/ g.yo ba dang*/ 'khrigs pa dang*/ 'gul ba'i nyams drag po dang*/ rlung gi khyer ba ltar snang*/ shes pa mar me ltar shin tu gsal ba bkra lam pa 'byung bar 'dug snyam du g.yon gyi ra yig la sems bstad/ gnad lnga pa'o/ /de nas ra yig de yang dbus kyi a shad la thim/ nam zhig nam mkha' rnam shes la thim pa na/

rnam shes kyi nang nas snang ba dkar lam/ mched pa dmar lam/ thob pa nag lam/ 'od gsal spros bral gsal zhing rig pa rnams sems nam mkha' g.ya' dag lta bu phyogs cha nye ring med pa la 'char ba yin pa 'dug snyam pa dang*/ dbus kyi a shad la yun ring du sems bstad/ mthar de yang mi dmigs par dbyings su thim pa la/ cung zad bzhag /gnad drug pa'o/ /yang de las dgyes rdor ram bdag med ma gtso rkyang ngam dkyil 'khor skad cig gis bsgom/ sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya gnad bdun pa'o/ /gnad dang po drug 'od gsal dang*/ phyi ma sgyu lus yin/ de ka yang yang bsgom pa dmigs rten gcig yin la/ 'di'i nang gi gnad bdun pa de la/ dmigs skor re rer byas nas 'tsham par 'ong bas deng sang 'khrid 'debs pa rnams kyi de bzhin du byas na legs so/ /'chi ba'i dus su phyi'i rtags rnams rang gi mi shes kyang*/ nang rtags rnams dngos su myong bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ da lta nas yang yang dran pa'i sgo nas 'dris 'jug pa gal che mod/ blo 'khobs chung bas sgom stabs mi bde na/ sa chu la thim pa yin snyam pa nas/ rnam shes 'od gsal du thim pa yin snyam pa'i bar dran tsam bya ste/ de dag dge sbyor gyi gzhi bca' ba ste gnyid sad kyi gdams ngag yin no/ /de ltar dmigs pa de 'byongs par byung na/ nyal khar yang de bzhin du bsgom ste/ gnyid la rim gyis 'gro ba'i rim pa bzhi la/ yi ge so so sbyor ba'i bshad pa tsam yod kyang*/ da lta'i gang zag gis lag len tu mi khel bas/ gnyid mi bro ba rig pa dwangs su/ sngar gyi dmigs pa de rdzogs par bsgom/ a shad la sems bstad pa'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /dmigs skor

gcig /de ltar yang goms pas gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin yong zhing*/ yang nyin par sngar gyi dmigs pa de bsgom nas a shad la sems gtod pa'i skabs/ da lta mi rtog pa bsgom pa'i rjes su/ gzhan gyis bar ma chod par lha sku sgyu ma lta bu bsgom dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa btang*/ de rjes a shad de yang mi dmigs par sbyangs te sems ci gnas gnas su bzhag /de'i 'phro bcad de rang nyid yi dam du wal gyis bsgoms nas/ snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i rang zhal la che re blta bar bya'o/ /dmigs pa 'di skyar gyin yang yang bsgom dmigs skor gnyis/ yang de'i steng du do nub gnyid 'thug po'i skabs su mi rtog pa bsgoms/ rmi lam du lha sku snang stong bsgom dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa bsnan te bsgom/ dmigs skor gsum/ nyin par de bzhin bsgom/ nyal khar a shad la sems gtod pa'i skabs/ da lta gnyid 'thug po la 'od gsal zin pa zhig dang*/ rmi lam lha skur 'char ba zhig byed dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa lhang nge ba'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ de 'dra lan mang du song na gnyid 'thug po dang rmi lam la nges par yong ba yin no/ /dmigs skor bzhi ste/ dge sbyor gnyid dang bsre ba'o/ /dmigs pa de rnams 'byongs pa'i skabs ni/ nyin par sngar gyi dmigs pa'i steng du/ 'dun pa bsnan te/ nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus su 'di ltar sgom rgyu yin/ phyi nang gi snang ba thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes par bya/ 'chi ba 'od gsal bya ba yang da lta a shad yal ba'i dus kyi mi rtog pa 'di ka 'dra ba zha ི ga yin/ sems kyi rang bzhin spros bral bde stong 'di la rang ngo shes pa'i sgo nas gnas pa zhig byed dgos snyam pa dang*/ de las langs te lha skur shar ba'i dus bar dor yang 'di lta bu bsgom rgyu yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa bya/ dmigs skor gcig yang nyal ba'i dus su 'dun pa de ka kha spos te/ nam zhig 'chi ba'i tshe yang*/

da lta gnyid 'od gsal du 'jug pa'i gdams pa 'di ka bsgom rgyu yin snyam pa ste dmigs skor gnyis/ de'i steng du bar do'i gnas skabs su yang da lta'i rmi lam dang 'dra bar lha sku snang stong 'di ka sgom dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa sbyangs/ dmigs skor gsum mo/ /des gnyid 'thug po'i skabs su yang*/ 'chi ba dang bsre ba'i dran pa cung zad yong zhing*/ rmi lam lha skur shar ba'i skabs bar do dang bsre ba'i 'dun pa gsal po 'byung*/ de rnams dge sbyor 'chi ba dang bsre ba'o/ /da lta gson po'i dus su sad dus dang gnyid kyi dge sbyor de skyong thub na/ 'chi ba 'od gsal ngos zin par the tshom med do/ / chos sku ngos bzung ba'i gdam ngag 'di rnams dmigs pa de nyid 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa shas che yang bar do'i gdams ngag dang 'brel che bas bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bar do sgyu ma'i skabs 'dir ston pa mdzad pa yin la/ 'on kyang slob dpon rngog zhe sdang rdo rje'i man ngag yig chung rnams kyi nang na sgyu lus kyi yig chung tshig sna ring thung 'dra min gsum yod/ don la khyad med de de dag nas 'od gsal las lha skur ldang ba 'di rnams gsal ba ma byung*/ rang lugs kyi gdams ngag dang mos lugs kyi gdams ngag la yod de/ 'di nges par dgos/ gzhan du na spyir sgyu lus kyi gdams ngag yin par mi 'gro/ sgos bar do'i gdams ngag yin pa'i rgyu mtshan med par 'gyur ro/ /yig chung de dag tu mi gsal ba yang tshig sna thung ba dang gab pa yin gyi/ rgyud bshad las gsal ba'i phyir mi bzhed pa ma yin no/ /gnyis pa sgyu lus la brten na zung 'jug gi sku ngos 'dzin pa ni/ sngon 'gro dkyus dang 'dra/ dmigs pa sngar gyi yi ge lnga 'od gsal du bsdu ba'i bar de dag sngon du song na legs/ ma song rung 'dra ste mi rtog pa la cung zad bzhag /de nas rang gzhan phyi nang gi snang ba kun la gzhig 'brel zhig bcug

/'di thams cad bar do'i snang ba yin par 'dug ma 'khrul bar bya snyam nas rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad dgyes pa rdo rje'i bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor du bsgyur/ sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa sbyangs/ sgra thams cad sngags kyi sgra 'ur bar bsgom/ de yang sgyu mar bsgom/ gtum mo las rgya 'od gsal sogs kyi nyams myong bde stong gi 'char sgo yod na des rgyas btab/ med na bar do dang sgyu ma'i 'dun pa sngon du song nas/ rig pa gsal stong 'di la cher re ba bltas pas bde cha zhig rnyed yong*/ de gyes rdor gyi thugs su mos pa bya/ de ltar yang yang bsgom pa dmigs skor gcig /thun mtshams thams cad du yang bar do'i 'dun pa bya'o/ /yang rnam grangs gcig la da lta bar do min yang*/ nam zhig srid pa bar do'i snang ba 'byung bas skabs der yang 'di bzhin du sgom pa yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa bstar chags su byed kyin/ dmigs pa snga ma bzhin ka bsgom/ thun mtshams su yang bar do de yang 'di ka 'dra ba zhig yin/ 'di la 'khrul na de dus kyang 'khrul 'gro bas/ 'di la ma 'khrul ba zhig byed/ nyon mongs chags sdang dang*/ rnam rtog tha mal ba'i dbang du mi gtong snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po yang yang sleb par bya/ dmigs skor gnyis/ de nas dmigs pa de gnyis snga dro phyi dro spel zhing sgom par bya ste dmigs skor gsum mo/ /thun mtshams su yang res bar do thim par bya'o snyam pa dang*/ res bar do rang yin pa 'dug snyam pa spel zhing bsgom pa de ka nyin khril gyis bsgom/ mtshan mo nyal khar yang bsgom pas/ rmi lam du thun thun mtshams kyi dmigs pa thams cad dran zhing bsgom pa 'byung*/ khyad par du yang snying rang nas bar do yin par 'dug snyam pa dang*/ ma 'khrul par byed dgos pa'i 'dun pa drag po dang*/ rang dang snang ba ji ltar 'os pa lha skur 'gyur 'gro ba dang*/ sgra'i snang ba sngags su 'gyur 'gro ba dang*/

de thams cad bden med du shes pa dang*/ gtum mo sogs dran tsam gyis sems bde stong spros bral du 'char ba rnams rim pas 'byung ste/ mthar thams cad 'dzom pa de rmi lam du yang yang 'ong na/ bar do chod nus pa yin no/ /de yang 'chi ba chos sku dngos su ngo 'phrod na tha mal gyi bar do mi yong bar bar do'i 'od gsal lha sku rang shar du 'byung*/ 'chi ba 'od gsal lam du khyer yang*/ ji bzhin mngon du ma gyur na/ dang por bar do tha mal ba de 'byung*/ de nas gdams ngag 'di bsgoms pas/ bar dor lus lha sku/ sems bde stong*/ snang ba sgyu mar 'char ba yin/ de'i rgyun du bsgoms pas phal cher bar do bdun phrag dang po lta bu la lam chod par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa 'gro drug gi skye sgo dgag pa ni/ dbang po tha ma zhig la/ bar do gnyis par bshad pa'i sgom rgyud la skyes nas zhag bdun sogs bar do'i tshe tshad gcig la bsgoms kyang*/ sgom yun thung pas da dung lam ma chod/ mngal skyes su skye bar 'gyur na/ skye ba len 'gyur gyis pha mar 'gro rgyu de dag gsal bar mthong zhing*/ 'khrig pa'i sbyor ba la chags sdang mig ser skyes nas/ skye gnas ngan par dbang med du skye ba len dgos pa srid pas/ de 'gogs pa la gdams ngag 'di bsgom dgos so/ /de yang bar do'i gdams ngag snga ma gnyis sngon du btang nas/ thun gyi skabs su 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can pho mo thams cad yid du byas nas/ bar do yi chags sdang skyer mi rung*/ der ma zad/ 'di thams cad bla ma'i ye shes kyi cho 'khrul yin/ bla ma ni sangs rgyas kun 'dus dgyes rdor yab yum yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa sngon du btang nas/ skyes pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus te rtsa ba'i bla mar gyur/ bud med thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa slob dpon gyi yum du gyur/ de yang sku'i rnam pa he ru ka yab yum du gyur te/ de la mchod pa phul/ gsol ba btab dbang gzhi yongs rdzogs sam/

dbang bzhi'i gtso bo rnams sam byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gcig la dbang bzhi bsdus pa len pa rnams blo 'khobs che chung ngam mos pa dang bstun nas dbang len pa gang rung zha ི ga bya/ thun mtshams thams cad du yang pho mthong tshad bla ma he ru ka dang*/ mo mthong tshad rig ma bdag med mar mos pa bya/ skabs 'dir bshad pa'i skabs bla ma dang yi dam 'dam khar mdzad kyang*/ lag len du bla ma yi dam dbyer med du byed pa nyid gnad yin no/ /dmigs pa 'di 'byongs pas bar do bdun phrag snga phyi'i mtshams su skye sgo khegs nas/ yang bar do'i lus phyi ma la sngar gyi gdams ngag bsgoms pas grol bar bzhed do/ /bzhi pa skye sgo ma khegs na skye gnas 'dam pa'i gdams ngag ni/ bar do'i gdams ngag gi 'phros don no/ /de yang dmigs pa snga ma'i rjes thogs su/ gal te bdag bar dor grol bar ma gyur na/ lha'am mi spyir sdig pa spangs shing chos la spyod pa/ sgos su sngags kyi theg pa la spyod pa/ yang sgos su dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i chos la spyod pa zhig tu skye bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa dang*/ skye bar gyur cig snyam pa'i smon lam btab nas/ gang du skye ba len pa'i gzhi pha ma yin snyam pa de/ gong bzhin bla ma he ru ka yab yum du bsgoms nas dbang bzhi blang*/ skye ba blangs pa'i tshul du/ rang nyid bla ma he ru ka yab yum gyi sku la thim/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag /tshul 'di sgoms na bar dor yang skye ba bzang po khyad par can gang du len par 'gyur ba'i gnas dang pha ma sogs ngo shes shing rang dbang yod bzhin du/ skye ba mchog len par 'gyur de/ 'di skye ba brgyud nas/ sangs rgya ba'i gdams ngag go /gsum pa 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag la/ 'od gsal don bzhi ma las 'byung ba bzhin du/ rtsa ba'i rkang grangs rnam pa bzhi yin te/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag sgom pa'i 'od gsal dang*/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal dang*/ 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag ste bzhi las/

dang po ni/ snang grags snod bcud kyi chos thams cad ji ltar snang ba'i cha rnams bden med sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ gnas lugs sam/ stong lugs de 'od gsal yin par shes pa'i go don zhig dmigs bstad du bzhag nas bsgoms te/ de yang sngon 'gro sogs sngar dang 'dra ba las/ lus gnad bcas/ mig lta stangs gang bde ba cig tu bzhag /rlung ro bsal/ rlung rang babs su bzhag /sems chams kyis bskyur/ lhod kyi slod pa'i ngang nas/ rig pa sems kyi rang so bzung*/ rang ngo de la gsal le hrig ge bzhag /'di rtsa ba yin te dmigs skor gcig /de la nyams myong skyes na skye med mtha' bral du ngo sprad dmigs skor gnyis/ de nas da lta'i snang ba 'di ka'i steng du tshogs drug lhug par bzhag /dmigs skor gsum/ yang snang ba 'di ka'i steng du/ snang ba 'char mkhan gyi rig pa dang*/ snang ba rang dbyer med pa'i rang zhal la rjen ne blta ba/ dmigs skor bzhi/ de nas snang grags 'di thams cad kyi gnas lugs sems rang bzhin 'od gsal du ngo sprad de/ dper na sprin rnams dang por nam mkha' las byung*/ bar du nam mkha'i rang bzhin las ma 'das/ mthar thim yang nam mkha' la thim pa dper byas te/ snang grags 'di dag dang por rig pa sems kyi steng du snang cha tsam du shar/ bar du yang sems kyi rang bzhin las gzhan du ma grub/ sems kyi snang ba yin/ thim yang sems kyi nang du thim/ byung gnas thim gsum yang 'char sgo tsam ma gtogs/ ngo bo la khyad par cung zad tsam med par ngo sprad do/ /dmigs skor lnga/ de nas nyams myong de nyid 'gro ba dang*/ 'chag pa dang*/ 'dug pa dang*/ zas za ba dang*/ gleng bslang sogs bya ba gang byed la bsre/ dge sbyor gzhan la'ang bsre/ snang cha bden med dang*/ rang bzhin 'od gsal yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang skabs skabs su dran par bya/ dmigs skor drug go /'dir gnas lugs phyag chen pa rnams/ 'dun pa bsgom pa lta bu blos bzhag gi sgom la rtsis su mi byed/

rngaug pa'i 'od gsal don bzhi ma las/ ji skad du/ bya ba ci byed kyang 'od gsal yin te/ 'od gsal yin snyam du blos bzhag gin yang dang yang du bsgom/ zhes dngos su 'byung bas/ chos skad dag mi 'dra/ rje sgam po pas kyang tshogs chos zhig na/ rngog jo sras gtum mo 'od gsal du byed par 'dod pa la dgag pa mdzad/ 'bri khung bas kyang chen po gsum gyis ma reg gsung nas/ sngags gsar ma pa'i lugs kyi phyag chen des rang bzhed phyag chen gyi go mchod par mdzad 'dug /des na mar rngog lugs kyi phyag chen de/ sngags gsar ma pa'i phyag chen yin pas/ lugs gnyis ka brgyud pa rje mar pa la thug pa gzhir bzhag kyang*/ mar rngog 'tshur gsum sngags pa'i lugs yin/ rje mi la'ang don la 'di ka bzhed de/ dri lan bco brgyad pa las/ gsang sngags*/ bas kyi che ba yin/ /lta ba mtho zhes nga mi zer/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rje dwags po la gsungs bsgros mdzad tsa na yang*/ rig pa rkyang med kyis zhes mi gsung*/ ma bcos so ma la zhog ces kyang mi gsung bar gtum mo a thung sgoms shig /nam zhig na sems kyi ngo bo mthong gi zhes gsungs pas mtshon/ des na phyis byon mang po zhig /mar rngog gi bzhed pa'i mthar thug kyang gnas lugs phyag chen rang yin pa gzhir bzhag gis hang brdeg mang po byed de don thog tu 'khel ba dka'/ shab shob tu ka 'gro nyen gda'/ des na bzhed pa mi 'dra ba rnams so sor 'byed shes shing*/ gnad kyi don la dgongs pa mi 'gal ba zhig shes dgos so/ /skabs 'dir yang gnas skabs su blo bzhag gi gdams pa de/ phugs blo 'das la skyel ba'i thabs chen po zhig yin pas chos skad mi 'dra yang dgongs pa'i gnad gcig par go bar bya'o/ /da ni dkyus la 'jug ste/ sngar gyi nyams myong de la bogs dbyung ba ni/ snang ba'i mtshan nyid skye ba med/ 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid gzhi rtsa bral/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid zung du 'jug

/bla ma'i mtshan nyid rgyud par ldan/ zhes jo bo nā ro pa'i gdugs kyi yuu ba la bris yod skad/ de yang da lta'i snang ba sna tshogs pa 'di dag don la grub pa med de/ rang gi gdong du snang ba'i bum snam sogs dngos po gang yin gcig la sems bstad na/ der snang tsam de bkod pa'i khyad par la 'khrul bar 'dugadangos po de nyid kyi cha shas so so la brtags pas/ cha shas re re la bum snam sogs med la/ cha shas ma yin pa'i spyi bo yang mi 'dug cing*/ de gnyis las gzhan yang ma grub pas shin tu phra bas bltas na bum snam med/ ma brtags tsa na stong pa de ka bum snam du lam me snang*/ de ltar na phyi gzung ba ma grub/ de ma grub pas 'dzin byed kyi shes pa yang 'khrul pa'o/ /rgyu gzung ba yul dang 'dzin pa yul can skad cig snga ma la bden don ma grub pas/ phyi ma skye bar snang ba yang log snang tsam ma gtogs grub pa med do/ /de ltar yang yang bsgoms te dmigs skor bdun pa'o/ /de ltar na chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i phyir/ 'khor ba yod pa ma yin te/ yod na rgyu rkyen gzhi rtsa gcig las skye dgos pa las/ gzhi rtsa las dang nyon mongs bag chags las 'khor ba 'byung bar snang yang*/ las nyon bag chags nyid gdod nas ma grub pa'i phyir 'khor ba yang gzhi med rtsa bral lo/ /dmigs skor brgyad/ sems kyi rang bzhin de gnas phyi nang bar gsum gang na'ang med kha dog dbyibs sogs mtshan nyid gang yang ma grub pa la sems 'jog ste/ dmigs skor dgu/ stong pa rkyang pa'ang ma yin te/ rang bzhin gang du'ang ma grub pa zhig rig pa'i ngo bor 'dug

/de ka dbang bzhi gsum gyi dus su myong ba'i rang bzhin bde ba de kho nar snang ba'i ngo shes dran par bya/ 'di la snang ba sems su shes/ sems stong par shes/ stong pa bde bar shes pa'i tha snyad mdzad do/ /dmigs skor bcu pa'o/ /de nyid rtogs pa'i thabs bla ma'i byin rlabs yin pas gsol ba 'debs shing*/ mnyes pa thams cad kyis bla ma dgyes par bya'o/ /de yan chad la dmigs skor bcu gcig yod/ gzhan yang dbang po rang log dang*/ sems ye shes su shar ba dang*/ gnyis med thug phrad dang*/ chu bo rgyun gyis rnal 'byor dang*/ du ma ro gcig dang*/ so so rang rig dang*/ mar me lta bu dang*/ 'khor 'das dbyer med dang*/ mnyam rjes tha mi dad ces ngo sprod dgos te/ sgom pa lhongs su gyur pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /chos tshul 'di phyag chen chos drug ces so sor 'byed pa'i lugs ma yin/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po zhes gcig tu byed pa'i lugs yin no/ /gnyis pa bsgom pa'i 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag la/ 'od gsal gyi gzhi bca' ba dang*/ nyams myong bogs 'byin gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ dbang nyams phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba de yin te/ rnam rtog ma spangs na sems can/ spangs na sangs rgyas yin te/ de spong ba la e waṃ dgos gsungs te/ e nam mkha' la/ waṃ rig pa g.yo med du 'ching ba yin/ de'i man ngag ni/ lus gnad bcas lta stangs nam mkhar blta ste/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i sor sdud nyin mo'i rnal 'byor sgra ji bzhin yin/ 'di bsgom na shes pa bying ba mi 'byung*/ rtags lnga 'phral du 'char/ mi rtog pa skye/ drod dang bde ba shugs la 'byung ngo*/ /gnyis pa bogs 'byin pa ni/ gsal na rang zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa lta bur bsgom/ bsdu na yab phyag gnyis pa'am bdag med mar bsgom/ thugs kar padma dmar po dang nyi ma la hūṃ nag po zhig bsgom/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu thams cad khyab/

snod 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gzhal yas khang du gyur nas/ sems can la thim/ bcud sems can thams cad dgyes rdor ram/ bdag med mar gyur nas rang la thim/ rang gi lus steng 'og dang mtha' rnams nas tshur 'dus te/ hūṃ yig gdan bcas la thim/ gdan pad nyi hūṃ la thim/ zhabs kyu/ khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla phyed/ thig le/ nā da rnams rim pas bsdus/ nā da yang stong par sbyang ngo*/ /de ka'i ngang der ci nus bzhag cing*/ sngar gyi nyams myong yod na bskyang*/ yang lha skur phra gsal gyis bsgom par bya/ 'di ni rjes su gzhig pa'i rnal 'byor te/ rngog lugs dgyes rdor gyi skabs 'dir ril 'dzin gyi dmigs pa mi mdzad do/ / gang zag gi rigs kha cig la bsgoms pa'i 'od gsal gyi man ngag kho na la bslabs pas/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi nyams myong rang shugs la 'byung ba'ang yod mod kyi/ phar cher ni thog mar rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi man ngag la/ nyams myong ci rigs par chud pa'i rjes su 'di bsgoms na bogs chen por 'gyur te/ de dag ni gnyid sad dus kyi 'od gsal bsgom pa'i gdams pa'o/ /gsum pa gnyid kyi 'od gsal bsgom pa'i man ngag ni/ sngar gtum mo'am/ sgyu lus sam/ bshad ma thag pa'i sad dus kyi 'od gsal la nyams myong yod na 'di la tshegs med/ kha cig la rang shugs su 'char ba yang yod/ de dag ma bsgoms kyang*/ gdams pa 'di la brten nas 'od gsal myur du zin par 'gyur/ de la gnyid kyi 'od gsal 'dzin pa dngos dang*/ gnyid dang nyin par bsre ba gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ rang gi snying khar rtsa padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar hūṃ sngon po/ 'dab ma bzhi la mdun nas g.yas skor gyi a nu ta ra bzhi po yang kha dog sngon po bsgom gsung*/ sngon po thugs mtshon pa yin pas snying gar de bzhin du 'thad mod/ kha dog tsam la nges pa yang med pas/ spyir man ngag lag len gtso che'o/ /gang ltar yang yi ge lnga gar bsgoms nas thog mar a la sems bstad/

de nu la thim pa dang*/ de ta la thim pa dang*/ de ra la thim pa rnams la'ang*/ yud re yud re sems bstad nas/ rang yang dbus kyi hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ yig la yun ring du sems bzung*/ de yang mi dmigs par cung zad bzhag /thun re'i nang du de lta bu yang yang bsgom/ mtshams bcad la tshul des zla gcig sogs bsgom/ de bar la rang shugs kyi 'od gsal zin na ni legs/ ma zin na rtsis btab mi bya'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi ni/ kha zas dang*/ sku mnye sogs kyis lus brtas par byas/ zhag gcig gnyis gnyid bcag /mkha' 'gro la gtor ma phul/ snying kha'i yi ge gzhan bzhi la rim can du sems bstad/ mthar hūṃ la sems bstad pa'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar byed pa'o/ /des 'od gsal zin 'ong*/ gal te ma zin na bskyar te bsgom pa dang*/ grogs kyis blta ba la sogs pa/ rim lnga dang chos drug sogs spyi dang 'dra/ skabs 'dir yang*/ gnyid 'thug po la rim pas 'jug pa'i gnas skabs so so dang bstun nas/ yi ge lnga la sems gtod tshul sogs bshad kyang*/ dag sbyor sgrib pa'i go ba tsam yin gyi/ lag len la 'khel ba dka' bas/ gong du bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /go don la yang rgyud gzhung dang bstun nas/ snang mched thob gsum rtsa 'dab so so la sbyar ba de cung zad mi bde bar mngon no/ /gnyis pa gnyid dang nyin snang bsre ba ni/ rang gi mdun 'thangs gsal zhing blta stabs bde ba zhig tu bris sku 'grem pa'am/ yang na cung zad mun nag par bris sku bkram/ de la me long sogs kyi 'od gtong ba'i lugs gnyis yod de/ phyi ma de yang yang lcogs dka' bas/ bogs 'don lan re tsam ma gtogs/ snga ma la lag len byed gsung*/ gang ltar yang sngon 'gro rnams so/ /lus gnad bcas sems rnal du phab/ bris sku la mig dang sems bstad nas cung zad bzhag /blo yul du gsal sing shar ba de sgyu ma lta bur dran par bya/ de ma thag mig mi lta bar blo yul du gsal ba de'i ngo bo la che re bltas pas/

rim pas snang ba nub pa'i ngang der shes pa bzo med du bzhag /bde stong gi nyams myong yod na rgyas btab ste bsgom yang bris sku la blta ba sogs sngar bzhin rtag tu bsgom/ dmigs skor gcig /cung zad 'byongs nas bris sku spangs te yid yul du 'char ba la bslab/ dmigs skor gnyis/ de la gom na gnyid khres te sad pa'i skabs der/ lha sku sgyu ma lta bur lam te 'char thub pa byed/ de nas sngar bzhin sgom/ mtshan mo nyal khar yang*/ de ltar bsgoms pas lha sku yal ba dang gnyid 'od gsal du bsre/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i nyin mtshan 'dre ba yin/ dmigs skor gsum mo/ /de ltar na sad dus dang gnyid kyi 'od gsal sgom pa'i gdams pa de dag ni/ brtson 'grus can tshe 'dir sangs rgya ba'i lam mo/ /'di la'ang yig chung rnying pa na mtshams de nas spyod pa spyad/ nye rgyu'i sgrub pa zhag bdun gyis 'bras bu sangs rgyas la sbyor ba sogs kyi rnam gzhag mdzad de/ lam blo chod kyi dbang du byas par gda' na'ang*/ gtum mo sgyu lus 'od gsal rnams lam rim gcig tu sgrig pa rang legs so/ /bzhi pa 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag ni/ go babs dang bshad sgros 'brel chags pa la brten nas gong du bshad zin te/ bar do dang po 'chi ba 'od gsal la brten nas chos sku ngos bzung ba zhes bya ba de yin/ yang na gong du sa bcad tsam smos nas/ dmigs pa de skabs 'dir bstan kyang rung ngo*/ /de dag gis ni bsre ba'i gdams ngag rnams bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa 'pho ba'i gdams ngag la/ gong du 'pho ba dang*/ grong du 'jug pa gnyis so/ /dang po la sbyangs te 'pho ba dang*/ btsan thabs su 'pho ba gnyis/ dang po la sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis/ sbyor ba la rlung sbyang ba dang sgo dgag pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ bum pa can la bslab pa yin te/ bum can rab 'bring tha ma gsum gang rung gcig khegs pa dgos/ gnyis pa ni/ rang lus khong stong du gnas pa'i tshangs bug tu kṣuṃ yig mgo bo thur bstan/

mig gnyis dang smin mtshams su hūṃ re re rna ba gnyis dang*/ sna bug gnyis su yum re re/ kha dang chu lam la suṃ/ lte bar rnams mgo nang bstan dang*/ 'og sgor kṣuṃ yig mgo gyen bstan no/ bsre 'pho'i yig chung gnyis na mi gsal yang mkha' 'gro rnams kyi grangs tshang ba'i phyir dang*/ drod dang dbugs dang rnam shes 'pho ba'i gnas yin pa'i phyir dang*/ gdan bzhi kha sbyor rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams las gsal bar gsungs pa nyid kyi phyir/ mgrin par / snying gar / dpung gnyis pa la rnams kyang bsgom dgos te/ yi ge rnams kyi kha dog ni/ suṃ dkar po/ kṣuṃ ser po/ gzhan rnams sngon po'am nag po zhes bshad/ yi ge thams cad mgo bo nang du blta ba'o/ /yi ge de rnams las 'od zer 'phros te/ sgo rnams bar mtshams med par bkag par bsams la rlung bum pa can drag tu bzung*/ de nyid zla shas bsgoms pas sgo khegs pa'i rtags 'byung*/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ yang sgo dgag pa snga ma bzhin sngon du song nas lte ba'i thad kyi rgyab gzhung gi dbus su/ rig pa sems kyi rgyal po a yig dkar po 'od 'phro ba la sems bstad de/ bum pa can sgom ste/ de yang zla ba gcig tshun gyis bde drod kyi nyams myong cung zad skye'o/ /'di'i yi ge zhig na lte 'og sor bzhir a bsgom gsung ba'ang yod de'ang ma kha'o/ /dmigs skor gcig /de nas rlung cung zad nang du bzung nas/ slar kha nas dal bus btang pa dang lhan cig tu/ rlung thengs gcig la hika nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pa'i tha ma de la/ hīka zhes phyi la drag tu phul/ de nas nang du dal bus rngub pa na/ ka hī nyi shu rtsa gcig dran par bya/ ka hī 'di ngag nas brjod mi dgos/ kha nas rngub kyang mi rung ba med mod/ sna nas rngub pa nyid bzang zhing*/ rlung rngubs zin pa na lto ba phyir bkyed de/ rgyu zhabs su gnon/ de nyid yang yang bsgom/ thun bzhir brgya rtsa sogs sbyangs te zhag bdun tsam du de ltar bya/

dmigs skor gnyis so/ /de nas sgo dgag pa gong bzhin/ sgal tshigs nyi shu rtsa gcig gi gnas su/ zlum po kha dog dkar po steng 'og rim pa nyi shu rtsa gcig /de dag gi 'og tu a yig sngar bzhin bsgom/ de nas rlung sbyor snga ma bzhin las/ hika re re brjod pa na tshigs pa re re la a yig de 'phar zhing steng du 'gro bar bsam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pa la a yig de tshangs bug gi sgor lhan gyis song*/ yi ge'i mgor phyir nyug nyug yod par bsam/ yang rlung nang du drangs pa na/ a yig de an stong rus pa'i steng du babs/ ka hī re re dang bstun nas/ sgal tshig nyi shu rtsa gcig la babs nas/ sngar gyi shul du sgreng nge 'dug par bsam/ de ltar thun bzhir yang yang sbyangs pas/ thog mar zas mang du yod pa dang*/ de nas dpral bar rtul zhing tsha chil ba dang*/ de nas 'tshog ma'am/ spyi gtsug brdol ba snyam byed pa 'byung*/ rngog pa'i bzhed kyi de dag ni 'pho ba'i rtags tsam yin gyi 'pho ba 'byongs ba rang min la/ yar 'pho ba'i dmigs pa bstad pa'i skabs/ da lta'i snang ba 'di nub tshad pa dang*/ spyi gtsug tu na zug chen po rang ma yin pa'i shugs chen po sgring sgring ba 'byung*/ mar 'bebs pa'i dmigs pa bsgoms pas lte 'og tu tsha chil ba dang*/ bde cham pa dang*/ shugs chen po sgring sgring ba/ da lta'i snang ba 'di shin tu gsal ba la/ chu nang gi rde'u ltar yul yul ba 'byung*/ bsgom res kyi de ltar yong na 'pho ba 'byongs pa yin gsung ba/ gnad dang ldan pa nges tig can gyi zhal sgros su snang ngo*/ /dmigs skor gsum pa ste de dag ni 'pho ba sbyang ba'o/ /las la sbyar ba ni/ gnas khang yid dang mthun par/ dgyes rdor yab yum gyi sku gzugs dgram/ mchod gtor bshams/ lcogs na cho gas phul/ mi lcogs na yid kyis phul/ de nas sngar gyi 'pho ba'i dmigs pa de lan kha yar sbyangs/ de rjes lte 'og sor bzhir a sngar bzhin bsgom/

rkang mthil gnyis/ mkhal khung gnyis/ mchan khung gnyis te drug tu yum yig mgo bo nang du blta ba rlung gi shugs 'od zer dang bcas pa bsgom/ snying gar padma 'dab bzhi kha thur bstan/ lte bar hūṃ sngon po mgo bo thur bstan dang*/ 'dab ma bzhi la'ang yum yig sngon po mgo bo thur bstan bsgom/ de nas rlung sbyor dang hika sngar bzhin byas pas lte ba'i a de yar 'phar zhing 'ongs nas snying ga'i hūṃ la thim/ de skabs padma kha gyen du bstan/ hūṃ sogs yi ge lnga po yang rang rang gi thad ka brdol nas/ mgo bo gyen bstan du yod pa las/ yum yig bcu po'i rlung shugs kyis hūṃ gyen du yer yer bteg /hūṃ yig spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mthon la khad khad pa la/ sngar snying ga'i padma'i lte ba nas hūṃ gi zhabs kyu'i bar la/ 'od zer ba thag lta bus sbrel nas yod pa de/ skabs der pad kyis chad nas/ hūṃ de mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du yi dam gyis thugs kar thim mo/ / de lta bu lan gcig gis ma 'phos kyang*/ bskyar gyin bsgoms pas 'pho ste lan nyi shu rtsa gsum rtsa bzhi bsgoms pas mi 'pho ba mi srid gsung*/ dmigs pa 'di yig chung gi dngos bstan la las la sbyar ba kho na'i skabs su bshad kyang*/ snga rol nas ma bsgoms na/ skabs der gsal thebs pa dka' bas/ sbyong ba'i dus nas zhag re la lan re tsam re bsgom dgos so/ /yig chung rnams las tshangs bug gi kṣuṃ yig bsam nas 'pho bar bshad de/ 'gog dgos rgyu dang*/ dbye dgos rgyu'i lam gnyis yod pas dkyus bzhin bsgom pa legs so/ / dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /gnyis pa btsan thabs su 'pho ba'i gdams ngag ni/ sngar 'pho ba ma sbyangs pa la/ 'chi nges nad kyis thebs na/ shul la ma chags shing*/ dge rtsa 'dra byed du gzhug /dad pa'am snying rje sogs dge sems gcig gsal btab/ ye shes btsan thabs su bskyed pas 'pho na/ lus tsog pur byed/ ol mdud lan gsum g.yas g.yon du gcu/

de nas drang por 'dug la/ smin phrag tu thig le dkar po la sems bstad/ mig zim me pa la mig 'bras mi g.yo bar bzhag /rang ngam grogs kyis longs spyod kyi rlabs mnan zhing bsgom pa'o/ /yang na dmigs pas btsan thabs su 'pho ba zhes bya ba/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma'am yi dam bsgom/ spyi bo tshangs bug skya ha re 'dug /snying ga padma 'dab bzhi kha gyen bstan gyi dbus na/ rig pa sems a yig ba thag dang bcas pa de/ hika nyer gcig brjod pas tshangs bug nas thon/ ba thag rbad kyi chad nas bla ma'am yi dam gyi thugs kar thim par bsgoms pas 'pho nus/ 'di la kha'i rlung gis ol mdud kyi shugs ltag pa'i mdud sgo'i phyogs su 'phul zhing*/ mthe bong dang gung mdzub kyi shugs kyis ol mdud kyi g.yas g.yon gnyis nas sdom zhes gsung pa'ang 'dug ste/ nges par dgos pa min la/ yang gong gi 'pho ba chen mo mi lcogs na/ dmigs pa 'di la spyi dang mtshungs par mar 'bebs pa'i dmigs pa mnan nas sbyangs te 'pho ba'i lugs bsgom du bcug kyang legs so/ /'di'i 'phros don la/ lus gnad bcos pa'i 'pho ba bya ba zhig yod de/ de yang dmigs pa ye bsgom mi shes pa'am mi thub na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus kyi bzhugs stangs dang 'dra ba/ phyogs ma 'chol bar nyal du bcug

/phyi dbugs chad tsa na/ spyi bo'i steng phyogs su sgra snyan po bag tsam drag po ma yin pa'i gling bu'am/ ting shag lta bu rol mo phra mo bya/ spyi gtsug gi skra nas mthen pa'am/ reg tsam reg tsam byed/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bzhugs stangs byin rlabs rten 'brel gyi gnad kyis ngan 'gro'i sgo khegs pa yin gsung ngo*/ /gal te dmigs pa gsal thebs na dmigs pa yang bsgom ste/ lte 'og sor bzhir nyi ma la a/ de las 'od dmar nar byung ste/ spyi gtsug tshangs bug phye/ sgal tshigs nyer gcig padma nyer gcig ika ces pa nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas an tong du sleb/ nyer gnyis pas spyi gtsug nas 'thon/ yi dam gyi thugs kar reg rjes slar yang spyi bor bsdad/ nyer gsum pa brjod pas ba thag chad/ yi dam gyi thugs kar thim/ zha ེ sa yig chung na bshad 'dug /dkyus kyi dmigs skor la mi 'gro/ 'di la nyams khrid skyong ba'i srol med do/ /gnyis pa grong du 'jug pa ni/ bden med sgyu ma blo 'byongs/ bskyed rim la gsal snang thob/ rlung legs par byang ba gcig gis yi dam dang mkha' 'gro la gsol ba btab nas gnang ba thob pa gcig gis sgrubs na 'grub/ de yang thod pa srubs med pa sor lnga pa gcig la rtsi nag pos byug pa'i dbus su/ hūṃ dkar po bris/ dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig gi dbus su bzhag /rang gi rlung sems snying ga'i hūṃ la bsdus pa de/ rlung phyir 'gro ba dang lhan cig sna sgo nas rgyangs te thon nas/ thod tshal phye hūṃ la thim/ de la mig dang sems drag tu bstad/ rang la ma zhen ma chags pa dang*/ hūṃ la zhen zhing chags par bya/ de ltar bsgoms pas de la 'bar ba dang*/ g.yo ba dang*/ dro ba la sogs pa'i rtags 'byung*/ rang lus kyi snang ba mi gsal/ rang gi sems hūṃ gi sa de na yod par snang zhing myong ba 'byung*/ des ni 'byongs pa yin te/ de nas bar chad kyis ma khyer bar las la sbyar na 'grub ste/

rgyas par rgyud 'grel dang yi ge snga ma rnams su shes par bya la/ da lta nyer mkho chung bas 'dir rgyas par ma smos so/ /grong 'jug 'di thun mong gi dngos grub yin te/ ral gri mig sman sogs kyi sde pa cha yin/ gtum mo 'od gsal sogs kyi grwa sdebs min/ sgyu 'phrul gyi dngos grub dang 'di gnyis ral gri sogs de dag la cung zad 'grub sla bar rgya gar pa rnams la grags/ 'di rdzogs rim gyi khrid yin rgyu med na'ang*/ gong du 'pho ba dang 'brel chags pa la brten nas/ 'phros don du bshad par 'dug /rje 'brog mi dang rje mar pa gnyis kar 'pho ba'i 'phros la grong 'jug gi rnam gzhag re gsungs gin yod 'dug pas/ bod 'dir shin tu grags che bar gyur te grong 'jug lam gyi 'thud ma zhes zer ba de byung ba yin/ des na bsre 'pho las phye ste/ chos drug dang*/ brgyad dang*/ bcu la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag byed tsa na/ gtum mo sgyu lus sogs dang 'dra bar brtsis te/ grong 'jug lam gyi rkangs su byed pa ni mi legs te/ gzhan du ni ri lu mig sman sogs kyang*/ chos drug la sogs pa'i sde tshan gyi rkangs su thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gong du 'pho ba dang ni mi 'dra ste/ de ni rlung sems dbu mar 'jug pa dang 'ching ba'i thabs yin pa'i phyir/ rdzogs rim dngos sam rjes mthun gang rung yin zhing 'do gsal gyi cha lag go /ji skad du/ gal tai sku gsum ma grub na'ang*/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso bor 'gyur/ /gsungs pa'i yang phyir ro/ /'pho ba dang grong 'jug 'di dag /dgyes rdor rtsa bshad las/ zur gyi 'phangs pa ma gtogs dngos su mi gsal te/ gdan bzhi sogs nas kha bskang ba ni yin la/ 'on kyang rje mar pa nyid kyis bka' srol/ gdan gzhi'i man ngag gi skabs su byung ba rnams dang*/ dmigs pa 'dra min cung zad yod mod/ 'ga' zhig 'dam kha dang*/ 'ga' zhig rgyas bsdus dang*/ kha cig grub thob so so'i man ngag mi 'dra ba yin pa'i phyir/

'gal bar mi bsam zhing phan tshun bsre bar yang mi bya'o/ /de dag gis ni dgyes rdor gyi man ngag bsre 'pho zhes grags pa/ lho brag mar pa'i thugs bcud bsre slad med pa rngog ston yab sras la bka' babs pa'i lugs te ma nor bar bstan zin to/ /smras pa/ phyogs 'dir nā ro chos drug ces bya bar/ /grags pa'i 'khrid tshul mi 'dra mang yod kyang*/ /lhad med man ngag 'di 'dra shin tu dkon/ /chos drug mchog kyang 'di nyid kho na yin/ /rgyab rten phyogs 'dra'i yig sna bsdus pa la/ /bsre 'pho'i po ti zhes su bar skabs grags/ /phyis nas de la 'khrid tshul log pa bsgrigs/ /bshad rtsom cha lag mi 'dra du ma brtsams/ /rgyud sde 'di la brten zhes rgyab rten med/ /dbang dang bskyed rim nges med thun tshigs bsdus/ /spros bcas 'gog cing las tshogs la dga' ba'i/ /'gal 'du can la dam pa thams cad khrel/ /dmigs bstad rgyab brten rgyud dang ma bral zhing*/ /dbang dang rim gnyis 'dzom pa zab mo'i lam/ /rgyab rten rdzun la mi 'tshol drang po'i chos/ /mar rngaug bzhed pa ji bzhin 'di na ko/ //༄༅/ /rnal 'byor ma dpal 'khor lo la/ /mchog tu gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /mchog gyur man ngag zab mo yi/ /nyams len rim pa mdo tsam bri/ / da ni grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ri khrod pas dngos su byin gyis rlabs pa/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug de ni/ rje btsun lho brag mar pas yun ring du bsten no/ /de la'ang dgyes rdor rtsa bshad dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa dang rab tu mi gnas shing yid la mi byed pa phyag rgya bzhi'i gdams pa rdzogs par gsan pa las skabs 'dir dgyes pa rdo rje la rdzogs rim lam dgu skor ram/ dgu phrugs su grags pa 'di byung ngo*/ /'di'i man ngag gi yi ge rnams las/ sngon 'gro logs pa ma gsungs mod/ khrid 'di logs su zhu na sngon 'gro rnams bsre 'pho dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/

/dngos gzhi la gtum mo'i man ngag /phyag rgya'i man ngag /phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag ste gsum mo/ /dang po la/ gtum mo nyid kyi sngon 'gro rlung sbyang ba dang*/ gtum mo dngos so/ /dang po la'ang man ngag rgyas pa dang bsdus pa gnyis/ dang po rgyas pa la/ rlung rgya yan la bslab pa/ bgrang zhing brts-i ba la bslab pa/ kha dog dang dbyibs la bslab pa/ bum pa can la bslab pa ste bzhi'o/ /dang po ni lus gnad bcas/ rlung ro lan mang du bsal/ de rjes rlung nang du nar gyis drangs/ de nas rlung rang babs su bzhag ste/ dbugs phyi 'gro nang 'gro la sems bstad/ rlung mgyogs bul dang*/ gang nas bzlog /gang gi bar du 'gro/ gang gi tshe spyi na gnas pa lta ba kho na yin/ dmigs pa gzhan med/ gnyis pa bgrang ba la/ bgrang ba dngos dang 'jog pa dang*/ rjes 'gro dang rnam dag ste bzhi yod pa las/ dang po la dus ni chags lam la thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pa'i dus/ thur sel rang shugs kyi gyen du bzlog pa'i skabs de yin/ grol lam la dang por rlung nang du song nas/ de rjes phyir zlog pa'i skabs de yin/ bsam pa ni/ lte bar āḥ gsang bar oṃ/ snying ga'am mgrin par hūṃ/ de gsum las rlung 'byung bar bsam/ gnas la dmigs pa ni/ de dag gang nas 'byung lta ba yin/ grangs ni gcig nas bcu pa'i bar du ma 'khrul bar bgrod/ bzlas pa ni phyi 'gro oṃ/ 'jug pa hūṃ ste yi ge gnyis sam/ gnas pa āḥyang bsnan pas yi ge bcu gsum zha ེ sa gsungs/ 'di sgyu 'phrul chen po'i lugs yin/ dgyes rdor la 'jug pa oṃ/ gnas pa āḥ 'gro ba hūṃ zhes gsang 'dus bzhin du byed kyang gsungs te gang ltar byas kyang mi 'gal lo/ /de ltar bshad kyang lag len ni/ dang por rlung 'gro nang 'gro sdom pa/ lan bcu bcu'i bar du ma 'khrul bar bgrod pa nyid la rtag tu bslab ste dmigs skor gcig byed/ de nas rlung nang du 'jug pa'i dus/ mgrin pa'i oṃ dmar po las byung nas/

rkang mthil gyi bar du 'gro/ gnas pa bag tsam de lte ba'i ā la sems bstad/ phyir 'gro ba'i tshe gsang ba'i oṃ dkar po las byung nas/ spyi gtsug dang lag sor gyi bar du yang khyab par bsam/ dmigs pa 'di cung zad 'byongs 'byongs su bsgom ste 'di la'ang dmigs skor gcig byed/ de nas dmigs pa de'i steng du grangs ma nor bar bgrang tshul sngar bzhin bsnan te bsgom dgos pa yin/ 'di la dmigs skor gcig ste/ 'di rdor bzlas su grags pa nyid do/ /gnyis pa 'jog pa ni/ gnas pa yun je ring dang*/ 'byung 'jug gnyis yun thung ngur song bar bsgom mo/ /gsum pa rjes 'gro ni/ 'jug gnas ldang gsum yig 'bru dang bcas pa la sems zin pa'i zhi gnas skyes pa'o/ /bzhi pa rnam dag ni rlung mi rgyu bar 'gags gtum mo ci rigs 'bar/ thig le ci rigs pa zhu ba'i bde stong gi nyams lhag mthong skye ba'o/ /gsum pa kha dog dang dbyibs la bslab pa ni/ rlung phyir 'gro tsa na/ lte ba'am gsang ba nas 'od zer gyi rnam par byung*/ lus kyi dbus nas yar sker gyi langs/ sna sgo nas mthon te phyir rgyangs kyis 'gro ba rtsub pa shugs dang ldan pa/ 'od che ba zhig bsgom/ de yang nad gzhi grang shas che na dmar po dang*/ tsha shas che na dkar po dang*/ snyoms na sngon po'am/ sna lnga bsgom/ de nas rlung nang du 'ong ba'i tshe/ kha dog de dang 'dra ba la 'jam zhing shugs chung ba/ sngar gyi de phyi 'gros su ldog pa'i rnam pas phyung*/ mgrin pa'i 'og tsam nas kha dog dang dbyibs sangs te/ reg bya 'jam yul gyi lte bar sleb/ gnas pa'i tshe lte 'og tu yal bar bsam/ 'di'i rlung dbang du byed cing bde ba skye'o/ /bzhi pa bum pa can la bslab pa ni/ rim gyis dgag pa dang*/ btsan thabs su dgag pa gnyis so/ /dang po dbyung ba ni/ rlung ro lan bcu tsam phyir bsal ba dang*/ gnyis pa gzhug pa ni/ nang du 'then la dgag pa yin/ gsum pa zhi ba ni rngub chung byed pa ste/

'di goms na sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pas zhi ba'o/ /de gsum goms pas bzhi pa bum pa can gyi gnas skabs shugs la 'grub bo/ /btsan thabs su dgag pa ni/ seṅge rnam rol gyi phyag rgyas dgag pa ste/ 'di yang mahā mā ya'i lugs yin/ dgyes rdor gyi man ngag 'dir ma bshad kyang rung ngo*/ /rlung khrid rgyas pa 'di rje mai tri pa dang*/ dpal zhi ba bzang po'i man ngag dang gung spros pa yin/ gnyis pa rlung sbyang ba bsdus pa ni/ rlung btsan thabs su gzhug pa dang*/ rim gyis gzhug pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lus gnad me thab drug bcings bya/ lus zo ba zhabs med bzhin du/ sgrog rus yan dang*/ rgyu zhabs man med pa/ bar dum de yang phyi pags pa tsam ma gtogs sha khrag rus gsum med/ hūṃ zhes rlung phyir btang nas phyir cung zad bzung*/ dal bus shugs dang ldan par nang du drangs nas/ oṃ gyi sgra dang sbyar nang du cung zad bzung*/ rlung rnams lus kyi nang nas mar zhugs te 'og nas thon/ sa 'og thag ring por song nas yal bar bsam/ de yang dang por pho rlung shugs drag la thung bar 'dren pa dang*/ bar du mo rlung phra la ring bar drangs pas/ mthar ma ning gi rlung rang 'gags shugs la 'byung ngo*/ /gnyis pa rim gyis gzhug pa la/ mnga' bdag mai tri ba'i bzhed pa dang*/ thar pa'i lam ston gyi bzhed pa'o/ /dang po la dus tshod kyis rlung ngos bzung ste gzhug pa dang*/ mtshan mo nyal stabs kyis gzhug pa dang*/ g.yas g.yon du spo ba'i gnad kyis gzhug pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rlung g.yas g.yon phan tshun du 'pho ba'i mtshams de/ ye shes kyi rlung rgyu ba'i dus yin pas/ spyi bo nas nor bu'i bar du rtsa dbu ma dkar po/ sbom phra snyu gu tsam pa bsam/ hūṃ dang oṃ gyi rlung sbyor sngar bzhin byas pas/ phyir btang ba'i tshe/ spyi bo nas yar rgyang ste thon pa dang*/ nang du rngub pa'i tshe nor bu'i bar du zangs te song nas yal bar bsam/ gnyis pa ni/

rlung sna bug g.yas g.yon gang nas rgyu brtags la de phyogs kyi gzhogs 'og tu bcug /lag pas de phyogs kyi rtse'u chung yang btsir te nyal ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gdong g.yas g.yon du gcu ba lan gsum du zhi byas nas/ sna bug g.yas bkag /g.yon nas bus shing rngubs la rlung bzung ba thengs gsum bya/ yang gdong lan gsum du bcus nas/ sna bug g.yon pa bkag /g.yas nas 'bud rngub bzung ba lan gsum bya'o/ / de ltar mang du spel bas rlung cha mnyam du 'dug na dmigs pa dang po de bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa thar pa'i lam ston gyi bzhed pa la/ nam mkha' ltar dpangs bstod/ sa gzhi ltar rgya bskyed/ 'khor lo ltar bskor ba'am chu bo ltar drag tu bskyil/ lcags kyu ltar rab tu drangs/ zhes pa ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gong du bshad pa'i lus zo ba zhabs med lta bu la bslab pa de kho na las hūṃ oṃ ma sbyar ba yin/ 'dis zur gzer sogs zhi bar byed/ gnyis pa ni/ lus khong stong du mos/ 'jam rlung bzung bas lus je che je che la mtha' med par song bar bsam/ 'dis bde ba skye ste/ 'on kyang ye shes dang mthun pa'i bde ba ni min gsung ngo*/ /de gnyis rlung sbyang ba'o/ /de nas rlung kha sbyor du bzung ba'i ngang nas/ rgyu zhabs g.yas skor g.yon skor la bslab/ gnas der rlung nag po'am sngon po'am/ khams nag cig khyil li li 'khyil ba la sems bstad/ bzhi pa ni hūṃ hūṃ zhes lto ba 'gyur 'gyur ba bya zhing 'then pas/ rlung rnams rkang mthil dang rdo rje nor bu nas yar byung*/ rgyu zhabs nas lte ba'i bar du dmar breng breng 'dug pa la sems bstad/ de gnyis dbu ma'i mas snar rlung gzung ba'i gdams ngag go /gnyis pa gtum mo dngos la/ 'khor lo gcig la brten pa/ gnyis la brten pa/ bzhi la brten pa ste gtum mo'i gdams dag rnam pa gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ gzhan rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las/ rang gi lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan/
